    <!-- Theme Colors & Layout -->
    <style>
        :root {
            --theme-primary: #277563;
            --theme-primary-hover: #1f5f51;
            --theme-accent: #10b981;
            --theme-body-bg: #ffffff;
            --theme-header-bg: #ffffff;
            --theme-text-color: #333333;
        }

        /* Phones: no double-tap-to-zoom wait on anything tappable. Pinch
           and pan stay; only the double-tap gesture goes, so taps fire
           at once. */
        a, button, [role="button"], input, select, textarea, label, summary {
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        html,
        body {
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--theme-body-bg);
            color: var(--theme-text-color);
        }

        /* Prevent transition on page load */
        .no-transition,
        .no-transition * {
            transition: none !important;
        }

        /* Desktop Sidebar Body Offset */
        @media screen and (min-width: 1024px) {
            body.has-sidebar {
                padding-left: 240px;
            }

            body.has-sidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
                padding-left: 72px;
            }

            body.has-sidebar.transitions-enabled {
                transition: padding-left 0.3s ease;
            }
        }

        /* Prevent jump on page load */
        html.sidebar-initial-collapsed body.has-sidebar {
            padding-left: 72px;
        }

        html.is-mobile-view body.has-sidebar {
            padding-left: 0;
        }

        @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {
            body.has-sidebar {
                padding-left: 0 !important;
            }

    </style>

    <!-- Dark mode ("Display Mode"): palette vars + pre-paint boot + toggle -->
    <style>
    html.theme-dark {
        /* Native scrollbars, form controls, date pickers follow suit */
        color-scheme: dark;

        /* Admin palette (validated #rrggbb from settings) */
        --sd-bg: #14161a;
        --sd-surface: #1b1e24;
        --sd-surface-2: #23262d;
        --sd-line: #32363e;
        --sd-text: #e5e7ea;
        --sd-text-2: #a9b0b8;
        --sd-text-3: #8a919a;

        /* Site theme vars — outranks each layout's :root declaration */
        --theme-body-bg: var(--sd-bg);
        --theme-header-bg: var(--sd-surface);
        --theme-text-color: var(--sd-text);
        --theme-primary-text-color: var(--sd-text);
        --theme-primary: #15e5a0;
        --theme-primary-hover: color-mix(in srgb, #15e5a0 82%, #000000);
                /* Text ON the accent. The lit accent is a light colour, so the
           white that sits on the brand green in light mode drops to ~1.7:1
           on it; this near-black green is ~10:1. Used by the override
           list at the bottom of this file. */
        --sd-on-accent: #0b1f19;
        /* The light brand primary, for FILLS that keep white text (the
           primary -> accent gradient CTAs below). White on the lit accent
           is ~1.7:1; on the brand green it is the same ~5.5:1 as in light. */
        --sd-fill: #277563;

        /* Bridge Bulma's dark scheme (activated by the theme-dark class
           itself) onto the admin palette. Only the composite vars are
           pinned; hover/active shades still derive from Bulma's stock dark
           lightness machinery (h≈221 s≈14%) — the default palette matches
           those tones, so derived states blend. An admin picking a wildly
           different palette drifts hover shades toward Bulma stock, which
           is acceptable. */
        --bulma-scheme-main: var(--sd-surface);
        --bulma-scheme-main-bis: var(--sd-surface-2);
        --bulma-scheme-main-ter: var(--sd-surface-2);
        --bulma-background: var(--sd-surface-2);
        --bulma-body-background-color: var(--sd-bg);
        --bulma-border: var(--sd-line);
        --bulma-border-weak: var(--sd-line);
        --bulma-text: var(--sd-text);
        --bulma-text-strong: var(--sd-text);
        --bulma-text-weak: var(--sd-text-3);

        /* Left sidebar: the admin's light-tuned hover/active picks read
           wrong on dark, so remap them wholesale */
        --sidebar-hover-bg: var(--sd-surface-2);
        --sidebar-hover-text: var(--sd-text);
        --sidebar-active-bg: var(--sd-surface-2);
        /* Active-state text (sidebar row, home/category/search chips,
           sort trigger) follows the dark accent, not the light theme's
           accent colour: that one is tuned for white pages and is what
           kept "All"/"Random" on the old green after the dark accent
           changed. */
        --sidebar-active-text: var(--theme-primary);
        --sidebar-divider-color: #1b1d20;

        /* Messages/DM app shell (layouts/messages.php declares these on
           :root with hardcoded light values) */
        --mx-bg: var(--sd-bg);
        --mx-surface: var(--sd-surface);
        --mx-line: var(--sd-line);
        --mx-ink: var(--sd-text);
        --mx-ink-2: var(--sd-text-2);
        --mx-ink-3: var(--sd-text-3);
    }

    /* Accent-filled controls that hard-code white text (fine on the brand
       green in light mode, unreadable on the lit dark accent): the
       notification tabs and their count pills, the unread "99+" tag,
       pagination's current-page button, the discover search button and
       the subscribed page's primary button. One list here, so a brighter
       accent never has to be chased across views. !important because two
       of them are inline styles. */
    html.theme-dark .notif-tab.is-active,
    html.theme-dark .notif-tab-count,
    html.theme-dark .notif-page-header .tag,
    html.theme-dark .btn-primary-custom,
    html.theme-dark .sd-btn.is-primary,
    html.theme-dark .disc-bar button,
    html.theme-dark .ev-cat-pill.is-selected,
    html.theme-dark .pagination .button.is-small[style*="--theme-primary"],
    html.theme-dark .sidebar-link .sidebar-count {
        color: var(--sd-on-accent) !important;
    }

    /* Solid CTA buttons that keep WHITE text (channel subscribe/follow,
       discover follow, guest log in, verify resend, call, external-link
       continue, tag icon): white on the lit accent is ~1.7:1, so these
       fill with the brand green like the comment composer's buttons.
       State variants (active subscription tint, demoted follow, quiet
       log in, "following") keep their own quiet styling. */
    html.theme-dark .btn-sub:not(.is-active),
    html.theme-dark .chan-actions:not(.has-sub) .btn-follow,
    html.theme-dark .disc-btn:not(.following),
    html.theme-dark .guest-login-btn:not(.is-quiet),
    html.theme-dark .mobilebar-login,
    html.theme-dark .resend-btn,
    html.theme-dark .vcd-call,
    html.theme-dark .external-link-modal-btn-continue,
    html.theme-dark .tag-icon {
        background: var(--sd-fill);
        border-color: var(--sd-fill);
        color: #fff;
    }

    html.theme-dark .btn-sub:not(.is-active):hover,
    html.theme-dark .chan-actions:not(.has-sub) .btn-follow:hover,
    html.theme-dark .disc-btn:not(.following):hover,
    html.theme-dark .guest-login-btn:not(.is-quiet):hover,
    html.theme-dark .mobilebar-login:hover,
    html.theme-dark .resend-btn:hover,
    html.theme-dark .vcd-call:hover,
    html.theme-dark .external-link-modal-btn-continue:hover {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sd-fill) 82%, #000);
        border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sd-fill) 82%, #000);
        color: #fff;
    }

    /* Gradient CTAs (brand primary -> accent) that keep white text: in
       dark the primary var is the lit accent, which turned these into
       glowing blocks. Start them from the brand green as in light mode. */
    html.theme-dark .desktop-sidebar .upgrade-button,
    html.theme-dark .mobile-sidebar .upgrade-button,
    html.theme-dark .reset-box .button.is-primary,
    html.theme-dark .register-box .button.is-primary,
    html.theme-dark .disabled-registration-box {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sd-fill) 0%, var(--theme-accent, #10b981) 100%);
    }
</style>

<!-- Pre-paint: apply the saved display mode before anything renders -->
<script>
    (function() {
        try {
            if (localStorage.getItem('siteDark') === '1') {
                var c = document.documentElement.classList;
                c.remove('theme-light');
                c.add('theme-dark');
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    })();

    // Display Mode rows in the header dropdowns call this. State lives on
    // <html> only; the switch pills are pure CSS keyed off that class, so
    // every toggle instance stays in sync with no per-pill JS. Instant,
    // client-side, idempotent — no busy state needed.
    function toggleSiteTheme() {
        var c = document.documentElement.classList;
        var dark = !c.contains('theme-dark');
        c.toggle('theme-dark', dark);
        c.toggle('theme-light', !dark);
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('siteDark', dark ? '1' : '0');
        } catch (e) {}
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-toggle]').forEach(function(b) {
            b.setAttribute('aria-checked', dark ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    }

    // The rows render with aria-checked="false"; correct them once the DOM
    // is up (the visual pill never lies — it's CSS off the html class).
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var dark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('theme-dark');
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-toggle]').forEach(function(b) {
            b.setAttribute('aria-checked', dark ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    });
</script>

    <!-- CRITICAL: Restore sidebar state BEFORE page renders -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                var isCollapsed = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true';
                if (isCollapsed) {
                    document.documentElement.classList.add('sidebar-initial-collapsed');
                }
            } else {
                // Mobile: remove has-sidebar padding
                document.documentElement.classList.add('is-mobile-view');
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <!-- Breadcrumb trail behind smartBack(). Needs to run on every page, not
         just the ones with a back button, or it has no history to reason about. -->
    <script defer src="https://sarapbabe.com/assets/js/nav-trail.js"></script>

    <!-- Header Codes -->
    <meta name="RATING" content="RTA-5042-1996-1400-1577-RTA" />
    </head>


<body class="no-transition has-sidebar">

    <!-- Header Navigation -->
    
    <!-- Brand wordmark font (any text-brand mode: icon + name, or name
         alone). Loaded here so every layout that pulls this partial gets
         it — the mobile sidebar brand in left-sidebar.php uses it too. -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=TikTok+Sans:opsz,wght@12..36,700..900&display=swap">

<style>
    :root {
        --theme-primary: #277563;
        --theme-primary-hover: #1f5f51;
        --theme-accent: #10b981;
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {

        .navbar,
        .navbar-brand,
        .navbar-menu {
            max-width: 100vw;
        }

        .navbar-brand,
        .navbar-menu {
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
    }



    .guest-login-btn {
        border-radius: 20px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        white-space: nowrap;
        background-color: var(--theme-primary);
        border-color: var(--theme-primary);
        color: white;
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    }



    .guest-login-btn:hover {
        background-color: var(--theme-primary-hover);
        border-color: var(--theme-primary-hover);
        color: white;
    }

    /* When the creator CTA is present it is THE primary action - login
       drops to a quiet secondary so the two pills don't compete */
    .guest-login-btn.is-quiet {
        background: transparent;
        border: 1px solid #e2e2e2;
        color: #4a4a4a;
    }

    .guest-login-btn.is-quiet:hover,
    .guest-login-btn.is-quiet:focus {
        background: #f5f5f5;
        border-color: #d5d5d5;
        color: #363636;
    }

    .guest-creator-btn {
        border-radius: 20px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        white-space: nowrap;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ec4899, #d6336c);
        border: none;
        color: white;
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .guest-creator-btn:hover,
    .guest-creator-btn:focus {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #db2777, #c2255c);
        color: white;
    }

    .guest-creator-btn .ui-ic {
        margin-right: 0.4rem;
    }

    /* Label shrinks with the viewport so the logo keeps its room:
       desktop "Become a Creator" -> mobile "Create & Earn" -> tiny "Create" */
    .guest-creator-btn .gc-full {
        display: none;
    }

    @media screen and (min-width: 1024px) {
        .guest-creator-btn .gc-full {
            display: inline;
        }

        .guest-creator-btn .gc-short,
        .guest-creator-btn .gc-tiny {
            display: none;
        }
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {

        /* Compact guest pills on mobile - the brand bar also holds the
           logo (clipped by overflow, not scaled, when space runs out) */
        .guest-creator-btn,
        .guest-login-btn {
            padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
            font-size: 0.8125rem;
        }

        /* One guest action on phones: the creator pill moves into the
           drawer (left-sidebar.php) and onto the sign-up page, and Log in
           takes the filled style it has when it stands alone. Desktop keeps
           the pill beside Log in. */
        .guest-creator-btn {
            display: none;
        }

        .guest-login-btn.is-quiet {
            background: var(--theme-primary);
            border-color: var(--theme-primary);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .guest-creator-btn .gc-tiny {
            display: none;
        }

        /* The toggle competes with the brand for width here — a full
           44px circle costs the site name its last characters */
        .icon-btn.dm-toggle {
            width: 34px;
            height: 34px;
        }
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 479px) {
        .guest-creator-btn .gc-short {
            display: none;
        }

        .guest-creator-btn .gc-tiny {
            display: inline;
        }
    }



    /* SVG brand: inline icon + site name text. The name is real text so it
       follows --theme-text-color, which dark-mode.php remaps — no separate
       dark logo asset needed. */
    .site-brand {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.45rem;
    }

    .site-brand .brand-svg {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* max-height beats Bulma's `.navbar-item img, .navbar-item svg
       { max-height: 1.75rem }` clamp, which otherwise shrinks the icon
       to 28px and rescales it inside its box (reads as blurry) */
    .site-brand .brand-svg svg,
    .site-brand .brand-svg img {
        height: 28px;
        max-height: 28px;
        width: auto;
        display: block;
    }

    .site-brand .brand-name {
        font-family: 'TikTok Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 1.35rem;
        letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        color: var(--theme-text-color);
        white-space: nowrap;
        line-height: 1;
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 479px) {
        .site-brand .brand-svg svg,
        .site-brand .brand-svg img {
            height: 24px;
            max-height: 24px;
        }

        .site-brand .brand-name {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
        }
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {

        /* The phone burger moved to the right end of the bar, so the brand
           is the first thing on the left and carries its own edge inset
           (the burger used to provide it). */
        .site-brand.navbar-item {
            padding-left: 1rem;
            padding-right: 0.25rem;
        }

        .site-brand {
            gap: 0.35rem;
        }
    }

    /* Phone drawer burger: same glyph size as the back bar's burger
       (partials/mobile-backbar.php .mobilebar-burger, 1.25rem) so the two
       headers' burgers match. */
    .nav-burger-phone i {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }

    /* Guest Dark Mode toggle: icon-only button beside Log in (the sidebar
       rows above Home are gone — they crowded the nav). Moon shows in
       light (tap → dark), sun in dark; the swap is pure CSS off the html
       class, aria-checked synced by the shared [data-theme-toggle] JS in
       dark-mode.php. Instant client-side toggle — no busy state needed. */
    .dm-toggle .ic-sun {
        display: none;
    }

    html.theme-dark .dm-toggle .ic-moon {
        display: none;
    }

    html.theme-dark .dm-toggle .ic-sun {
        display: inline-block;
    }

    /* Outline SVG icons (helpers/icons.php) used across the chrome: never
       squeezed by a flex row, and sit on the text baseline when inline. */
    .ui-ic {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        vertical-align: -0.2em;
    }

    @media screen and (min-width: 1024px) {
        .navbar-brand .navbar-item img {
            max-width: 200px !important;
        }
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {
        .navbar-brand {
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .navbar-item.is-hidden-desktop {
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
    }

    /* Burger wrapper. On desktop the icon must sit on the sidebar's icon
       column: sidebar links start at 12px + 8px padding and their 20px
       icons center at x=40, so a 40px button needs 20px of left inset
       (was 8px, which parked the burger 12px left of the column). */
    .nav-burger-wrap {
        padding: 0 0.5rem;
    }

    @media screen and (min-width: 1024px) {
        .nav-burger-wrap {
            padding-left: 20px;
        }
    }

    .hamburger-btn,
    .icon-btn {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        transition: background-color 0.2s;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    @media screen and (max-width: 1023px) {

        .hamburger-btn,
        .icon-btn {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
        }
    }

    .hamburger-btn:hover,
    .icon-btn:hover {
        background-color: #f5f5f5;
    }

    /* .search-input {
        border-radius: 24px 0 0 24px !important;
        border-right: none !important;
        background-color: #f8f9fa;
    }

    .search-input:focus {
        background-color: white;
        border-color: var(--theme-primary) !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .search-button {
        border-radius: 0 24px 24px 0 !important;
        background-color: var(--theme-primary) !important;
        border-color: var(--theme-primary) !important;
        color: white !important;
    }

    .search-button:hover {
        background-color: var(--theme-primary-hover) !important;
        border-color: var(--theme-primary-hover) !important;
    } */

    .search-icon-btn {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
        /* This is required to make it clickable */
        transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    /* Magnifier while the field is empty, a clear X once there is text
       (native iOS/Android search fields, YouTube, Instagram). The control
       gets .has-text from the script below. The X is a real button the
       full height of the field, so it is a thumb target, not an icon. */
    .search-clear-btn {
        display: none;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: #6b7280;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    .search-clear-btn:hover {
        color: #1c1917;
    }

    .control.has-text > .search-glass {
        display: none;
    }

    .control.has-text > .search-clear-btn {
        display: inline-flex;
    }

    html.theme-dark .search-clear-btn {
        color: var(--sd-text-3);
    }

    html.theme-dark .search-clear-btn:hover {
        color: var(--sd-text);
    }

    .search-icon-btn:hover {
        color: var(--theme-primary) !important;
    }

    .search-input {
        border-radius: 24px !important;
        background-color: #f5f5f5 !important;
        border: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        padding-left: 1.25rem !important;
        padding-right: 2.5rem !important;
        /* Makes room for the icon on the right */
        transition: background-color 0.2s;
    }

    .search-input:focus {
        background-color: #eeeeee !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .nav-user-avatar {
        width: 32px !important;
        height: 32px !important;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #f5f5f4;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        color: #78716c;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .nav-user-avatar img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        display: block;
        border-radius: 50%;
    }

    /* A photo fills the whole circle, so the initials gradient behind it
       is only ever visible as a green fringe blended into the image's
       antialiased circular edge (worst at mobile screen densities).
       Same fix the chatroom's .rm-ava:has(img) already uses. */
    .nav-user-avatar:has(img) {
        background: none;
    }

    /* z 110, not 100: pages that replace the navbar with the phone back bar
       (z 100, later in the DOM) open this overlay from the bar's Search
       pill, and at equal z-index the bar would paint over it. */
    .mobile-search-overlay {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: white;
        z-index: 110;
        transform: translateY(-100%);
        transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
    }

    .mobile-search-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.25rem;
        height: 52px;
        padding: 0 0.25rem 0 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
    }

    /* Plain text, no chrome: the sheet's dismiss, full bar height so it is
       a thumb target. */
    .mobile-search-cancel {
        height: 52px;
        padding: 0 0.75rem;
        border: 0;
        background: none;

    .messages-dropdown-avatar {

    .navbar-dropdown:has(#messagesDropdownList) .dropdown-divider,

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
        const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        const body = document.body;

        // A layout can remove the desktop sidebar with display:none (the
        // DM pane in layouts/messages.php does). Toggling its collapsed
        // class then changes nothing visible — a dead burger — so fall
        // through to the drawer, which that layout un-hides on desktop.
        const desktopShown = desktopSidebar && getComputedStyle(desktopSidebar).display !== 'none';

        if (isDesktop && desktopShown) {
            if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
            } else {
                desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
            }
        } else if (mobileSidebar) {
            // One surface at a time: the drawer replaces any open dropdown.
            ['mobileUserDropdown', 'mobileMessagesDropdown', 'mobileNotificationDropdown'].forEach(function (id) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('is-active');
            });
            mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
            body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
    }

    function closeMobileSidebar() {
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }



    function closeMobileSearch() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            searchInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }
    }

    // ── Clear X on the search fields ──
    // Swaps the magnifier for an X while there is text; the X wipes the
    // field and keeps focus, so the keyboard stays up and the recents and
    // trending lists come back (the field's own input listeners run).
    (function () {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.search-clear-btn'), function (btn) {
            var control = btn.parentElement;
            var input = control.querySelector('input');
            if (!input) return;
            var sync = function () { control.classList.toggle('has-text', input.value.trim() !== ''); };
            input.addEventListener('input', sync);
            btn.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }); // keep focus
            btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                input.value = '';
                input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                input.focus();
            });
            sync();
        });
    })();

    // ── Recent searches ──
    // localStorage, this device only, newest first, 8 max. Saved on submit
    // of either search form; listed in the phone overlay when it opens and
    // under the desktop box on focus. Rows are built with textContent so a
    // stored term can never become markup. Every storage access is wrapped:
    // private windows and blocked site data make the accessor throw.
    (function () {
        var KEY = 'recentSearches';
        var MAX = 8;
        var SEARCH_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search";
        var TRENDING_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search\/trending";
        var trendingPromise = null; // fetched once per page, only when a box opens empty

        function loadTrending() {
            if (!trendingPromise) {

            (n.from_avatar.startsWith('http') ? n.from_avatar : base + n.from_avatar) : '';
        const inner = src ?
            `<img src="${escapeHtml(src)}" alt="">` :
            escapeHtml(String(n.from_username).substring(0, 2).toUpperCase());
        return `<div class="notif-ava">${inner}${getNotificationBadge(n.type)}</div>`;
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text ?? '')
            .replace(/&/g, '&')
            .replace(/</g, '<')
            .replace(/>/g, '>')
            .replace(/"/g, '"')
            .replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    function markNotificationRead(id) {
        if (notifCache.all) {
            const hit = notifCache.all.find(n => n.id === id);
            if (hit) hit.is_read = true;
        }
        if (notifCache.unread) {
            notifCache.unread = notifCache.unread.filter(n => n.id !== id);
        }
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/mark-read/', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
            },
            body: 'id=' + id + '&csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
        });
    }

    function markAllNotificationsRead(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/mark-all-read/', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: 'csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
            })
            .then(() => {
                if (notifCache.all) notifCache.all.forEach(n => { n.is_read = true; });
                notifCache.unread = [];
                renderNotifSurfaces();
                updateNotificationBadge(0);
            });
    }

    function clearAllNotifications(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        const modal = document.getElementById('notifClearConfirm');
        if (modal) modal.hidden = false;
    }

    (function () {
        const modal = document.getElementById('notifClearConfirm');
        if (!modal) return;

        function closeNotifClearConfirm() { modal.hidden = true; }

        // stopPropagation keeps the dropdown behind the sheet open while
        // the user interacts with it (the document click-outside handlers
        // would otherwise close it under the backdrop).
        modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (e.target.closest('[data-close]')) closeNotifClearConfirm();
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) closeNotifClearConfirm();
        });

        document.getElementById('notifClearConfirmBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            closeNotifClearConfirm();
            fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/clear-all/', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                    },
                    body: 'csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
                })
                .then(() => {
                    notifCache.all = [];
                    notifCache.unread = [];
                    renderNotifSurfaces();
                    updateNotificationBadge(0);
                });
        });
    })();

    function updateNotificationBadge(count) {
        updateBadges(['notificationBadge', 'mobileNotificationBadge'], count);
        updateNotifTabCount(count);
    }

    function updateNotifTabCount(count) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.notif-tab-count').forEach(el => {
            el.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
            el.style.display = count > 0 ? '' : 'none';
        });
    }

    function fetchNotificationCount() {
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/unread-count/')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                const newCount = data.count || 0;
                const badge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
                const oldCount = badge ? (parseInt(badge.textContent) || 0) : 0;

                updateNotificationBadge(newCount);

                // If count increased, drop the cache so the dropdown refreshes
                if (newCount > oldCount) {
                    invalidateNotifCache();
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (notificationsOpen) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('notificationDropdown');
            if (dropdown && !dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
                closeDesktopNotifications();
            }
        }
    });

    
    // Shared badge update helper
    function updateBadges(ids, count) {
        const displayCount = count > 99 ? '99+' : count;
        const display = count > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
        ids.forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) {
                el.textContent = displayCount;
                el.style.display = display;
            }
        });
    }
</script>

<script>
    // Chatroom viewer counts. Fetched rather than server-rendered so the
    // number stays correct on FastCGI-cached pages. Response is public and
    // cached 15s, so most page loads never reach PHP at all.
    (function() {
        // Only pills still awaiting a value. Logged-in pages server-render
        // the count (no is-loading), so this fetch is guest-only — and on
        // the room page it can't overwrite the fresher number the room's
        // own setOnline() pushes into the current room's pill.
        const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-live[data-room].is-loading');
        if (!pills.length) return;

        function compact(n) {
            n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
            const units = [
                [1e12, 'T'],
                [1e9, 'B'],
                [1e6, 'M'],
                [1e3, 'K']
            ];
            for (const [div, suffix] of units) {
                if (n >= div) {
                    const v = n / div;
                    return (v >= 100 ? Math.round(v) : String(v.toFixed(1)).replace(/\.0$/, '')) + suffix;
                }
            }
            return String(n);
        }

        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/chatroom/api/counts', {
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                if (!d.success) return;
                pills.forEach(p => {
                    const n = parseInt(d.counts[p.dataset.room] ?? 0, 10) || 0;
                    p.querySelector('.sidebar-live-num').textContent = compact(n);
                    p.classList.toggle('is-zero', n === 0);
                    p.classList.remove('is-loading');
                });
            })
            .catch(() => {
                // Leave the pills hidden rather than showing a wrong number.
            });
    })();
</script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            var apiUrl = 'https://sarapbabe.com/api/views/';

            function fv(n) {
                if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
                if (n >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
                return n.toString();
            }

            function load() {
                var b = document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug]:not(.is-loaded)');
                if (!b.length) return;
                var s = [],
                    m = {};
                b.forEach(function(e) {
                    var slug = e.getAttribute('data-slug');
                    if (slug && !m[slug]) {
                        m[slug] = 1;
                        s.push(slug);
                    }
                });
                if (!s.length) return;
                fetch(apiUrl + '?slugs=' + encodeURIComponent(s.join(',')), {
                        method: 'GET',
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache'
                        }
                    })
                    .then(function(r) {
                        return r.json();
                    })
                    .then(function(d) {
                        Object.keys(d).forEach(function(slug) {
                            document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug="' + slug + '"]')
                                .forEach(function(badge) {
                                    var vc = badge.querySelector('.vc');
                                    if (vc) vc.textContent = fv(d[slug]);
                                    badge.classList.add('is-loaded');
                                });
                        });
                    })
                    .catch(function() {});
            }
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                    setTimeout(load, 50);
                });
            } else {
                setTimeout(load, 50);
            }
            window.refreshViews = load;
        })();
    </script>

               the index.

               Chromeless in the sidebar on purpose: post cards carry no
               container of their own (see post-card.php), so a bordered box
               here would be the heaviest thing on the page and would pull the
               eye off the feed. The sidebar column and its gutter already do
               the separating. */
            .recent-comments-widget {
                margin-top: 1.5rem;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
            }

            /* Mobile is the opposite case: the widget renders inline under the
               feed in the same column (layouts/main.php), so it needs a card to
               read as a separate block instead of more feed. */
            #recentCommentsWidgetMobile {
                padding: 0.85rem 0.6rem 0.8rem;
                background: #fff;
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.045);
                border-radius: 16px;
                box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
            }

            .rcw-header {
                padding: 0 0.55rem 0.55rem;
            }

            .rcw-title {
                font-weight: 600;
                font-size: 14px;
                letter-spacing: -0.01em;
                color: #1f1f1f;
            }

            .rcw-list {
                max-height: 360px;
                overflow-y: auto;
                scrollbar-width: thin;
                scrollbar-color: #e2e2e2 transparent;
            }

            .rcw-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
                width: 4px;
            }

            .rcw-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
                background: #e2e2e2;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }

            .rcw-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
                background: #cfcfcf;
            }

            .rcw-loading {
                text-align: center;
                padding: 1.5rem;
                color: #c4c4c4;
                font-size: 13px;
            }

            .rcw-item {
                display: flex;
                gap: 0.65rem;
                padding: 0.6rem 0.55rem;
                border-radius: 12px;
                text-decoration: none;
                color: inherit;
                transition: background 0.15s ease;
            }

            .rcw-item:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.035);
            }

            .rcw-avatar {
                width: 34px;
                height: 34px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                background: #f2f2f2;
                color: #b0b0b0;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                overflow: hidden;
            }

            .rcw-avatar img {
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
                object-fit: cover;
            }

            .rcw-body {
                flex: 1;
                min-width: 0;
            }

            .rcw-meta {
                font-size: 12px;
                color: #b3b3b3;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 0.35rem;
                margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
            }

            .rcw-username {
                font-weight: 600;
                color: #5a5a5a;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
            }

            .rcw-text {
                font-size: 13px;
                color: #2f2f2f;
                line-height: 1.5;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                display: -webkit-box;
                -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
                line-clamp: 2;
                -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            }

            .rcw-post-title {
                display: inline-block;
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-top: 0.35rem;
                padding: 2px 9px;
                border-radius: 999px;
                background: #f4f4f4;
                font-size: 11.5px;
                color: #8a8a8a;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
            }

            .rcw-item:hover .rcw-post-title {
                background: #ededed;
            }

            .rcw-see-more {
                display: block;
                margin: 0.55rem auto 0;
                padding: 7px 20px;
                background: #f4f4f4;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 999px;
                color: #6f6f6f;
                font-family: inherit;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                cursor: pointer;
                transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
            }

            .rcw-see-more:hover {
                background: #ececec;
                color: #333;
            }

            .rcw-empty {
                text-align: center;
                padding: 1.5rem;
                color: #c4c4c4;
                font-size: 13px;
            }

            /* Modal */
            .rcm-overlay {
                display: none;
                position: fixed;
                top: 0;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
                bottom: 0;
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
                z-index: 10000;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                padding: 1rem;
            }

            .rcm-overlay.show {
                display: flex;
            }

            .rcm-modal {
                background: #fff;
                border-radius: 18px;
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 480px;
                max-height: 80vh;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;

                    align-items: flex-end;
                    padding: 0;

                    max-width: 100%;
                    max-height: 85vh;
                    border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
                    animation: sheetUp 0.3s ease;

                .rcm-sheet-handle {
                    display: block !important;

                .rcm-modal-close {
                    display: none !important;

                    from {
                        transform: translateY(100%);
                    }

                    to {
                        transform: translateY(0);
                    }
                }
            }

            .rcm-modal-header {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: space-between;
                padding: 1rem 1.1rem 0.65rem;
                flex-shrink: 0;

            .rcm-modal-header h3 {
                font-size: 15px;
                font-weight: 600;
                letter-spacing: -0.01em;
                color: #1f1f1f;
                margin: 0;
            }

            .rcm-modal-close {
                background: none;

    <div class="rcm-overlay" id="rcmOverlay">
        <div class="rcm-modal">

                <div style="width:36px;height:4px;background:#ddd;border-radius:2px;margin:0 auto;"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="rcm-modal-header">
                <h3>Recent Comments</h3>
                <button class="rcm-modal-close" onclick="closeRecentCommentsModal()" style="width:32px;height:32px;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:#f4f4f4;"><i class="fas fa-times" style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#8a8a8a;"></i></button>
            </div>
            <div class="rcm-modal-list" id="rcmList"></div>
            <div class="rcm-loading-more" id="rcmLoadMore"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            let rcwLoaded = false;
            let rcmPage = 1;
            let rcmHasMore = false;
            let rcmLoading = false;

            function rcwEscape(text) {
                if (!text) return '';
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.textContent = String(text);
                return d.innerHTML;
            }

            function rcwTimeAgo(dt) {
                const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dt)) / 1000);
                if (diff < 60) return 'now';
                if (diff < 3600) return Math.floor(diff / 60) + 'm';
                if (diff < 86400) return Math.floor(diff / 3600) + 'h';
                if (diff < 604800) return Math.floor(diff / 86400) + 'd';
                return new Date(dt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
                    month: 'short',
                    day: 'numeric'
                });
            }

            function rcwRenderItem(c) {
                const initial = (c.username || '?')[0].toUpperCase();
                const avatar = c.avatar ?
                    `<img src="${rcwEscape(c.avatar)}" alt="" loading="lazy">` :
                    rcwEscape(initial);
                const text = rcwEscape(c.comment || '').substring(0, 120);
                const postTitle = rcwEscape(c.post_title || 'Untitled');
                const slug = c.post_slug || '';
                const commentId = parseInt(c.id, 10);

                return `<a href="https://sarapbabe.com/${slug}/#comment-${commentId}" class="rcw-item">
                <div class="rcw-avatar">${avatar}</div>
                <div class="rcw-body">
                    <div class="rcw-meta">
                        <span class="rcw-username">@${rcwEscape(c.username)}</span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span>${rcwTimeAgo(c.created_at)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="rcw-text">${text}</div>
                    <div class="rcw-post-title">${postTitle}</div>
                </div>
            </a>`;
            }

            function loadSidebarComments() {
                if (rcwLoaded) return;
                rcwLoaded = true;

                fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/api/recent-comments/?limit=5')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('rcwList');
                        if (!data.success || !data.comments || data.comments.length === 0) {
                            document.getElementById('recentCommentsWidget').style.display = 'none';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = data.comments.map(rcwRenderItem).join('');
                        document.getElementById('rcwSeeMore').style.display = '';
                    })
                    .catch(() => {
                        document.getElementById('rcwList').innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">Failed to load</div>';
                    });
            }

            window.openRecentCommentsModal = function() {
                rcmPage = 1;
                const overlay = document.getElementById('rcmOverlay');
                const list = document.getElementById('rcmList');
                overlay.classList.add('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:#c4c4c4;"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i></div>';
                loadModalComments(false);
            };

            window.closeRecentCommentsModal = function() {
                document.getElementById('rcmOverlay').classList.remove('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            };

            async function loadModalComments(append) {
                if (rcmLoading) return;
                rcmLoading = true;
                const loadMore = document.getElementById('rcmLoadMore');
                if (append) loadMore.style.display = 'block';

                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`https://sarapbabe.com/api/recent-comments/?limit=20&page=${rcmPage}`);
                    const data = await res.json();
                    const list = document.getElementById('rcmList');

                    if (data.success && data.comments.length > 0) {
                        const html = data.comments.map(rcwRenderItem).join('');
                        if (append) {
                            list.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
                        } else {
                            list.innerHTML = html;
                        }
                        rcmHasMore = data.has_more;
                        rcmPage++;
                    } else if (!append) {
                        list.innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">No comments yet</div>';
                        rcmHasMore = false;
                    } else {
                        rcmHasMore = false;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (!append) {
                        document.getElementById('rcmList').innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">Failed to load</div>';
                    }
                }

                loadMore.style.display = 'none';
                rcmLoading = false;
            }

            document.getElementById('rcmList')?.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
                if (rcmLoading || !rcmHasMore) return;
                if (this.scrollTop + this.clientHeight >= this.scrollHeight - 80) {
                    loadModalComments(true);
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('rcmOverlay')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closeRecentCommentsModal();
            });
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('rcmOverlay')?.classList.contains('show')) {
                    closeRecentCommentsModal();
                }
            });

            // Swipe down to dismiss on mobile
            (function() {
                var modal = document.querySelector('.rcm-modal');
                var handle = document.querySelector('.rcm-sheet-handle');
                if (!modal || !handle) return;
                var startY = 0,
                    currentY = 0,
                    dragging = false;

                var header = document.querySelector('.rcm-modal-header');
                [handle, header].forEach(function(el) {
                    if (!el) return;
                    el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                        startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                        currentY = 0;
                        dragging = true;
                        modal.style.transition = 'none';
                    }, {
                        passive: true
                    });

                    el.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
                        if (!dragging) return;
                        currentY = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
                        if (currentY > 0) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            modal.style.transform = 'translateY(' + currentY + 'px)';
                        }
                    }, {
                        passive: false
                    });

                    el.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
                        if (!dragging) return;
                        dragging = false;
                        modal.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease';
                        if (currentY > 100) {
                            modal.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                closeRecentCommentsModal();
                                modal.style.transform = '';
                                modal.style.transition = '';
                            }, 250);
                        } else {
                            modal.style.transform = '';
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                modal.style.transition = '';
                            }, 250);
                        }
                    });
                });
            })();

            // Move modal to body so it's not trapped inside is-hidden-touch aside
            var rcmOverlay = document.getElementById('rcmOverlay');
            if (rcmOverlay) {
                document.body.appendChild(rcmOverlay);
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadSidebarComments);
            } else {
                setTimeout(loadSidebarComments, 500);
            }
        })();
    </script>

                // Sync with initial state set in <head>

                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                }
            }

            // Enable transitions after initial state is set (double RAF for safety)
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    body.classList.remove('no-transition');
                    body.classList.add('transitions-enabled');
                });
            });
        });

        // Sidebar toggle - Desktop collapses, Mobile opens
        function toggleSidebar() {
            const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
            const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
            const body = document.body;

            if (isDesktop && desktopSidebar) {
                // Desktop: Toggle collapse state
                if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                    body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
                } else {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
                }
            } else if (mobileSidebar) {
                // Mobile: Open sidebar
                mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
                if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
                body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        }

        function closeMobileSidebar() {
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');

            if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');

<script>
    (function() {
        var modal = document.getElementById('externalLinkModal');
        if (!modal) return;
        var urlDisplay = document.getElementById('externalLinkUrl');
        var cancelBtn = document.getElementById('externalLinkCancel');
        var continueBtn = document.getElementById('externalLinkContinue');
        var scamWhere = document.getElementById('externalLinkScamWhere');
        var scamVia = document.getElementById('externalLinkScamVia');
        var pendingUrl = null;
        var COUNTDOWN = 5; // seconds Continue stays locked
        var continueLabel = continueBtn.innerHTML;
        var countdownTimer = null;

        // Name the messaging app in the scam warning when we recognize it.
        // Returns '' when the host is not a known messaging app; the "on X"
        // clause is then hidden. Matches the exact domain or a subdomain only,
        // so look-alikes such as notwhatsapp.com are not labeled as the real app.
        function scamChannelName(url) {
            var host = '';
            try { host = new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
            function is(d) { return host === d || host.slice(-(d.length + 1)) === '.' + d; }
            if (is('t.me') || is('telegram.me') || is('telegram.org')) return 'Telegram';
            if (is('wa.me') || is('whatsapp.com')) return 'WhatsApp';
            if (is('fb.com') || is('m.me') || is('facebook.com')) return 'Facebook';
            if (is('instagram.com')) return 'Instagram';
            return '';
        }

        function stopCountdown() {
            if (countdownTimer) { clearInterval(countdownTimer); countdownTimer = null; }
            continueBtn.disabled = false;
            continueBtn.innerHTML = continueLabel;
        }

        function startCountdown() {
            stopCountdown();
            var left = COUNTDOWN;
            var tick = function() {
                continueBtn.textContent = 'Continue (' + left + ')';
                if (left <= 0) { stopCountdown(); return; }
                left--;
            };
            continueBtn.disabled = true;
            tick();
            countdownTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
        }

        function closeModal() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            pendingUrl = null;
            stopCountdown();
        }
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        continueBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (pendingUrl) window.open(pendingUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
            closeModal();
        });
        modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.style.display === 'block') closeModal();
        });
        // curated: true for links the site owner placed (sidebar custom links);
        // they get the plain notice. Everything else is treated as user content.
        // Display only: pendingUrl keeps the full link (referral path/query
        // included) for Continue. Curated links show the bare domain so an
        // owner referral such as /@username never appears in the notice;
        // user-posted links keep the path so members can see where they go.
        window.showExternalLinkWarning = function(url, curated) {
            pendingUrl = url;
            try {
                var u = new URL(url);
                urlDisplay.textContent = curated ? u.hostname : u.hostname + u.pathname;
            } catch (e) {
                urlDisplay.textContent = url;
            }
            var where = scamChannelName(url);
            if (scamWhere) scamWhere.textContent = where;
            if (scamVia) scamVia.hidden = (where === '');
            modal.classList.toggle('is-curated', !!curated);
            modal.style.display = 'block';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            if (curated) stopCountdown(); else startCountdown();
        };
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var link = e.target.closest('.external-link');
            if (!link) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            showExternalLinkWarning(link.getAttribute('data-url') || link.href, link.getAttribute('data-curated') === '1');
        });
    })();
</script>

        function check() {

            var want = y > window.innerHeight * 2;
            if (want !== shown) {
                shown = want;
                btn.classList.toggle('is-visible', shown);

        }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
            if (!ticking) {
                ticking = true;

<script>
    (function () {
        if (window.appConfirm) return; // double-include guard
        var wrap = document.getElementById('app-dialog');
        var titleEl = document.getElementById('appdlg-title');
        var textEl = document.getElementById('appdlg-text');
        var okBtn = document.getElementById('appdlg-ok');
        var cancelBtn = document.getElementById('appdlg-cancel');
        var inputEl = document.getElementById('appdlg-input');
        var resolver = null;
        var mode = 'confirm';
        var prevFocus = null;

        function open(opts, newMode) {
            if (typeof opts === 'string') opts = { message: opts };
            opts = opts || {};
            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                if (resolver) settle(false); // a second dialog cancels the first
                resolver = resolve;
                mode = newMode;
                prevFocus = document.activeElement;
                titleEl.textContent = opts.title || (newMode === 'alert' ? 'Notice' : 'Are you sure?');
                textEl.textContent = opts.message || '';
                okBtn.textContent = opts.confirmText || 'OK';
                okBtn.className = 'appdlg-btn ' + (opts.danger ? 'is-danger' : 'is-primary');
                cancelBtn.textContent = opts.cancelText || 'Cancel';
                cancelBtn.hidden = newMode === 'alert';
                inputEl.hidden = newMode !== 'prompt';
                wrap.hidden = false;
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                if (newMode === 'prompt') {
                    inputEl.value = opts.value || '';
                    inputEl.placeholder = opts.placeholder || '';
                    inputEl.focus();
                } else {
                    (newMode === 'alert' || opts.danger ? okBtn : cancelBtn).focus();
                }
            });
        }

        function settle(ok) {
            if (wrap.hidden && !resolver) return;
            wrap.hidden = true;
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            var r = resolver;
            resolver = null;
            if (prevFocus && prevFocus.focus) { try { prevFocus.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
            prevFocus = null;
            if (r) r(mode === 'prompt' ? (ok ? inputEl.value : null) : ok);
        }

        window.appConfirm = function (opts) { return open(opts, 'confirm'); };
        window.appAlert = function (opts) { return open(opts, 'alert').then(function () {}); };
        window.appPrompt = function (opts) { return open(opts, 'prompt'); };

        // ── Toasts ──
        var toastZone = document.getElementById('app-toasts');
        window.appToast = function (opts) {
            if (typeof opts === 'string') opts = { message: opts };
            opts = opts || {};
            if (!toastZone) return null;
            var t = document.createElement('div');
            t.className = 'apptoast' + (opts.type === 'error' ? ' is-error' : opts.type === 'success' ? ' is-success' : '');
            var text = document.createElement('span');
            text.className = 'apptoast-text';
            text.textContent = opts.message || '';
            t.appendChild(text);
            var timer = null;
            function dismiss() {
                if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
                timer = null;
                if (!t.parentNode) return;
                t.classList.add('is-leaving');
                setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 200);
            }
            if (opts.action && opts.action.label) {
                var b = document.createElement('button');
                b.type = 'button';
                b.className = 'apptoast-action';
                b.textContent = opts.action.label;
                b.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    dismiss();
                    try { if (typeof opts.action.onClick === 'function') opts.action.onClick(); } catch (e) {}
                });
                t.appendChild(b);
            }
            // One toast of a kind at a time: a retry tapped twice must not
            // stack two "Couldn't connect" bars.
            if (opts.key) {
                var old = toastZone.querySelector('[data-key="' + opts.key + '"]');
                if (old) old.remove();
                t.dataset.key = opts.key;
            }
            toastZone.appendChild(t);
            var ms = opts.duration || (opts.action ? 7000 : 3000);
            timer = setTimeout(dismiss, ms);
            return { dismiss: dismiss };
        };

        // Standard failed-fetch handler. Call it from a catch after rolling
        // the optimistic state back; the Retry button re-runs the action.
        window.netFail = function (retry, message) {
            var offline = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine === false;
            return window.appToast({
                key: 'net',
                type: 'error',
                message: message || (offline ? "You're offline. Reconnect and tap Retry." : "Couldn't connect. Tap Retry."),
                action: typeof retry === 'function' ? { label: 'Retry', onClick: retry } : null
            });
        };

        inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); settle(true); }
        });

        wrap.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (e.target.closest('[data-close]')) settle(false);
        });
        okBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { settle(true); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && !wrap.hidden) settle(false);
        });

        // e.submitter fallback for older browsers
        var lastSubmitBtn = null;
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
            var b = e.target.closest('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"], button:not([type])');
            if (b && b.form) lastSubmitBtn = b;
        }, true);

        // Declarative confirms: intercept submits of [data-confirm] forms/buttons
        document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            var form = e.target;
            if (form.dataset.appConfirmed === '1') { delete form.dataset.appConfirmed; return; }
            var submitter = e.submitter || (lastSubmitBtn && lastSubmitBtn.form === form ? lastSubmitBtn : null);
            var src = (submitter && submitter.dataset.confirm !== undefined) ? submitter
                : (form.dataset.confirm !== undefined ? form : null);
            if (!src) return;
            e.preventDefault(); // admin global spinner checks defaultPrevented, so it stays off
            appConfirm({
                title: src.dataset.confirmTitle || 'Are you sure?',
                message: src.dataset.confirm,
                confirmText: src.dataset.confirmOk || 'Confirm',
                danger: src.dataset.confirmDanger !== undefined
            }).then(function (ok) {
                if (!ok) return;
                form.dataset.appConfirmed = '1';
                if (form.requestSubmit) form.requestSubmit(submitter || undefined);
                else form.submit();
            });
        }, true);
    })();
</script>

        --sd-on-accent: #0b1f19;

        --bulma-scheme-main: var(--sd-surface);

    function toggleSiteTheme() {

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
