<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
        const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        const body = document.body;

        // A layout can remove the desktop sidebar with display:none (the
        // DM pane in layouts/messages.php does). Toggling its collapsed
        // class then changes nothing visible — a dead burger — so fall
        // through to the drawer, which that layout un-hides on desktop.
        const desktopShown = desktopSidebar && getComputedStyle(desktopSidebar).display !== 'none';

        if (isDesktop && desktopShown) {
            if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
            } else {
                desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
            }
        } else if (mobileSidebar) {
            // One surface at a time: the drawer replaces any open dropdown.
            ['mobileUserDropdown', 'mobileMessagesDropdown', 'mobileNotificationDropdown'].forEach(function (id) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('is-active');
            });
            mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
            body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
    }

    function closeMobileSidebar() {
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }



    function closeMobileSearch() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            searchInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }
    }

    // ── Clear X on the search fields ──
    // Swaps the magnifier for an X while there is text; the X wipes the
    // field and keeps focus, so the keyboard stays up and the recents and
    // trending lists come back (the field's own input listeners run).
    (function () {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.search-clear-btn'), function (btn) {
            var control = btn.parentElement;
            var input = control.querySelector('input');
            if (!input) return;
            var sync = function () { control.classList.toggle('has-text', input.value.trim() !== ''); };
            input.addEventListener('input', sync);
            btn.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }); // keep focus
            btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                input.value = '';
                input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                input.focus();
            });
            sync();
        });
    })();

    // ── Recent searches ──
    // localStorage, this device only, newest first, 8 max. Saved on submit
    // of either search form; listed in the phone overlay when it opens and
    // under the desktop box on focus. Rows are built with textContent so a
    // stored term can never become markup. Every storage access is wrapped:
    // private windows and blocked site data make the accessor throw.
    (function () {
        var KEY = 'recentSearches';
        var MAX = 8;
        var SEARCH_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search";
        var TRENDING_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search\/trending";
        var trendingPromise = null; // fetched once per page, only when a box opens empty

        function loadTrending() {
            if (!trendingPromise) {
                trendingPromise = fetch(TRENDING_URL, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
                    .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : { terms: [] }; })
                    .then(function (d) { return Array.isArray(d.terms) ? d.terms.filter(function (t) { return typeof t === 'string' && t; }).slice(0, MAX) : []; })
                    .catch(function () { return []; });
            }
            return trendingPromise;
        }

        function read() {
            try {
                var a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
                return Array.isArray(a) ? a.filter(function (t) { return typeof t === 'string' && t; }).slice(0, MAX) : [];
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }

        function write(a) {
            try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(a.slice(0, MAX))); } catch (e) {}
        }

        function add(term) {
            term = String(term || '').trim().slice(0, 80);
            if (!term) return;
            var lower = term.toLowerCase();
            var a = read().filter(function (t) { return t.toLowerCase() !== lower; });
            a.unshift(term);
            write(a);
        }

        function remove(term) {
            write(read().filter(function (t) { return t !== term; }));
        }

        // mode 'recent' (clock, X per row, Clear) or 'trending' (flame, read-only)
        function fill(panel, items, mode) {
            var list = panel.querySelector('.search-recent-list');
            var head = panel.querySelector('.search-recent-head > span');
            list.textContent = '';
            panel.classList.toggle('is-trending', mode === 'trending');
            if (head) head.textContent = mode === 'trending' ? 'Trending' : 'Recent';
            items.forEach(function (term) {
                var li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'search-recent-item';
                var a = document.createElement('a');
                a.className = 'search-recent-link';
                a.href = SEARCH_URL + '?s=' + encodeURIComponent(term);
                var icon = document.createElement('i');
                icon.className = mode === 'trending' ? 'fas fa-arrow-trend-up' : 'far fa-clock';

        // stopPropagation keeps the dropdown behind the sheet open while
        // the user interacts with it (the document click-outside handlers
        // would otherwise close it under the backdrop).
        modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (e.target.closest('[data-close]')) closeNotifClearConfirm();
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) closeNotifClearConfirm();
        });

        document.getElementById('notifClearConfirmBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            closeNotifClearConfirm();
            fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/clear-all/', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                    },
                    body: 'csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
                })
                .then(() => {
                    notifCache.all = [];
                    notifCache.unread = [];
                    renderNotifSurfaces();
                    updateNotificationBadge(0);
                });
        });
    })();

    function updateNotificationBadge(count) {
        updateBadges(['notificationBadge', 'mobileNotificationBadge'], count);
        updateNotifTabCount(count);
    }

    function updateNotifTabCount(count) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.notif-tab-count').forEach(el => {
            el.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
            el.style.display = count > 0 ? '' : 'none';
        });
    }

    function fetchNotificationCount() {
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/unread-count/')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                const newCount = data.count || 0;
                const badge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
                const oldCount = badge ? (parseInt(badge.textContent) || 0) : 0;

                updateNotificationBadge(newCount);

                // If count increased, drop the cache so the dropdown refreshes
                if (newCount > oldCount) {
                    invalidateNotifCache();
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (notificationsOpen) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('notificationDropdown');
            if (dropdown && !dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
                closeDesktopNotifications();
            }
        }
    });

    
    // Shared badge update helper
    function updateBadges(ids, count) {
        const displayCount = count > 99 ? '99+' : count;
        const display = count > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
        ids.forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) {
                el.textContent = displayCount;
                el.style.display = display;
            }
        });
    }
</script>

<script>
    // Chatroom viewer counts. Fetched rather than server-rendered so the
    // number stays correct on FastCGI-cached pages. Response is public and
    // cached 15s, so most page loads never reach PHP at all.
    (function() {
        // Only pills still awaiting a value. Logged-in pages server-render
        // the count (no is-loading), so this fetch is guest-only — and on
        // the room page it can't overwrite the fresher number the room's
        // own setOnline() pushes into the current room's pill.
        const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-live[data-room].is-loading');
        if (!pills.length) return;

        function compact(n) {
            n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
            const units = [
                [1e12, 'T'],
                [1e9, 'B'],
                [1e6, 'M'],
                [1e3, 'K']
            ];
            for (const [div, suffix] of units) {
                if (n >= div) {
                    const v = n / div;
                    return (v >= 100 ? Math.round(v) : String(v.toFixed(1)).replace(/\.0$/, '')) + suffix;
                }
            }
            return String(n);
        }

        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/chatroom/api/counts', {
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                if (!d.success) return;
                pills.forEach(p => {
                    const n = parseInt(d.counts[p.dataset.room] ?? 0, 10) || 0;
                    p.querySelector('.sidebar-live-num').textContent = compact(n);
                    p.classList.toggle('is-zero', n === 0);
                    p.classList.remove('is-loading');
                });
            })
            .catch(() => {
                // Leave the pills hidden rather than showing a wrong number.
            });
    })();

        (function() {
            var apiUrl = 'https://sarapbabe.com/api/views/';

            function fv(n) {
                if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
                if (n >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
                return n.toString();
            }

            function load() {
                var b = document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug]:not(.is-loaded)');
                if (!b.length) return;
                var s = [],
                    m = {};
                b.forEach(function(e) {
                    var slug = e.getAttribute('data-slug');
                    if (slug && !m[slug]) {
                        m[slug] = 1;
                        s.push(slug);
                    }
                });
                if (!s.length) return;
                fetch(apiUrl + '?slugs=' + encodeURIComponent(s.join(',')), {
                        method: 'GET',
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache'
                        }
                    })
                    .then(function(r) {
                        return r.json();
                    })
                    .then(function(d) {
                        Object.keys(d).forEach(function(slug) {
                            document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug="' + slug + '"]')
                                .forEach(function(badge) {
                                    var vc = badge.querySelector('.vc');
                                    if (vc) vc.textContent = fv(d[slug]);
                                    badge.classList.add('is-loaded');
                                });
                        });
                    })
                    .catch(function() {});
            }
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                    setTimeout(load, 50);
                });
            } else {
                setTimeout(load, 50);
            }
            window.refreshViews = load;
        })();

    <script>
        (function() {
            // Viewability beacon: each data-inad element reports once per
            // pageload when >=50% visible. Ids are read from the served
            // (possibly edge-cached) DOM, so guests report exactly the ads
            // they were shown. CSS-hidden device variants never intersect.
            var beaconUrl = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/api\/spot\/seen\/";
            var seen = {};
            var queue = [];
            var flushTimer = null;

            function flush() {
                flushTimer = null;
                if (!queue.length) return;
                var ids = queue.splice(0, 10).join(',');
                var fd = new FormData();
                fd.append('ids', ids);
                try {
                    var vid = localStorage.getItem('vid');
                    if (vid) fd.append('vid', vid);
                } catch (e) { /* storage blocked - server falls back to IP+UA */ }

                if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
                    navigator.sendBeacon(beaconUrl, fd);
                } else {
                    fetch(beaconUrl, { method: 'POST', body: fd, keepalive: true }).catch(function() {});
                }
                if (queue.length) flushTimer = setTimeout(flush, 500);
            }

            function report(id) {
                if (seen[id]) return;
                seen[id] = true;
                queue.push(id);
                if (!flushTimer) flushTimer = setTimeout(flush, 800);
            }

            // This script is emitted where the partial is first required —
            // usually BEFORE the ad markup — so wait for the full DOM.
            // arm(root) is also exposed as window.inadArm for cards that
            // arrive later (infinite scroll appends them from a fetched
            // page); report() de-duplicates by id, so re-arming is safe.
            function arm(root) {
                var scope = (root && root.querySelectorAll) ? root : document;
                var els = Array.prototype.slice.call(scope.querySelectorAll('[data-inad]'));
                if (scope !== document && scope.hasAttribute && scope.hasAttribute('data-inad')) els.unshift(scope);
                if (!els.length) return;

                if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
                    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
                        entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                            if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5) {
                                report(entry.target.getAttribute('data-inad'));
                                io.unobserve(entry.target);
                            }
                        });
                    }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                    els.forEach(function(el) { io.observe(el); });
                } else {
                    // Ancient browser: count them as shown on load
                    els.forEach(function(el) { report(el.getAttribute('data-inad')); });
                }
            }

            window.inadArm = arm;
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { arm(); });
            } else {
                arm();
            }
        })();

                body.classList.add('has-sidebar');
                if (localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                }
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    body.classList.remove('no-transition');
                    body.classList.add('transitions-enabled');
                });
            });
        });

        function toggleSidebar() {
            const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
            const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
            const body = document.body;

            if (isDesktop && desktopSidebar) {
                if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                    body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
                } else {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
                }
            } else if (mobileSidebar) {
                mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
                if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
                body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        }

        function closeMobileSidebar() {
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');

            if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
            document.body.style.removeProperty('overflow');
        }

            if (searchOverlay) {

                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

        // Returns '' when the host is not a known messaging app; the "on X"
        // clause is then hidden. Matches the exact domain or a subdomain only,
        // so look-alikes such as notwhatsapp.com are not labeled as the real app.
        function scamChannelName(url) {
            var host = '';
            try { host = new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
            function is(d) { return host === d || host.slice(-(d.length + 1)) === '.' + d; }
            if (is('t.me') || is('telegram.me') || is('telegram.org')) return 'Telegram';

            if (is('fb.com') || is('m.me') || is('facebook.com')) return 'Facebook';

<!-- Pre-paint: apply the saved display mode before anything renders -->
<script>
    (function() {
        try {
            if (localStorage.getItem('siteDark') === '1') {
                var c = document.documentElement.classList;
                c.remove('theme-light');
                c.add('theme-dark');
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    })();

    // Display Mode rows in the header dropdowns call this. State lives on
    // <html> only; the switch pills are pure CSS keyed off that class, so
    // every toggle instance stays in sync with no per-pill JS. Instant,
    // client-side, idempotent — no busy state needed.
    function toggleSiteTheme() {
        var c = document.documentElement.classList;
        var dark = !c.contains('theme-dark');
        c.toggle('theme-dark', dark);
        c.toggle('theme-light', !dark);
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('siteDark', dark ? '1' : '0');
        } catch (e) {}
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-toggle]').forEach(function(b) {
            b.setAttribute('aria-checked', dark ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    }

    // The rows render with aria-checked="false"; correct them once the DOM
    // is up (the visual pill never lies — it's CSS off the html class).
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var dark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('theme-dark');
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-toggle]').forEach(function(b) {
            b.setAttribute('aria-checked', dark ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
        const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        const body = document.body;

        // A layout can remove the desktop sidebar with display:none (the
        // DM pane in layouts/messages.php does). Toggling its collapsed
        // class then changes nothing visible — a dead burger — so fall
        // through to the drawer, which that layout un-hides on desktop.
        const desktopShown = desktopSidebar && getComputedStyle(desktopSidebar).display !== 'none';

        if (isDesktop && desktopShown) {
            if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
            } else {
                desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
            }
        } else if (mobileSidebar) {
            // One surface at a time: the drawer replaces any open dropdown.
            ['mobileUserDropdown', 'mobileMessagesDropdown', 'mobileNotificationDropdown'].forEach(function (id) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('is-active');
            });
            mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
            body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
    }

    function closeMobileSidebar() {
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }



    function closeMobileSearch() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            searchInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }
    }

    // ── Clear X on the search fields ──
    // Swaps the magnifier for an X while there is text; the X wipes the
    // field and keeps focus, so the keyboard stays up and the recents and
    // trending lists come back (the field's own input listeners run).
    (function () {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.search-clear-btn'), function (btn) {
            var control = btn.parentElement;
            var input = control.querySelector('input');
            if (!input) return;
            var sync = function () { control.classList.toggle('has-text', input.value.trim() !== ''); };
            input.addEventListener('input', sync);
            btn.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }); // keep focus
            btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                input.value = '';
                input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                input.focus();
            });
            sync();
        });
    })();

    // ── Recent searches ──
    // localStorage, this device only, newest first, 8 max. Saved on submit
    // of either search form; listed in the phone overlay when it opens and
    // under the desktop box on focus. Rows are built with textContent so a
    // stored term can never become markup. Every storage access is wrapped:
    // private windows and blocked site data make the accessor throw.
    (function () {
        var KEY = 'recentSearches';
        var MAX = 8;
        var SEARCH_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search";
        var TRENDING_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search\/trending";
        var trendingPromise = null; // fetched once per page, only when a box opens empty

        function loadTrending() {
            if (!trendingPromise) {
                trendingPromise = fetch(TRENDING_URL, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
                    .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : { terms: [] }; })
                    .then(function (d) { return Array.isArray(d.terms) ? d.terms.filter(function (t) { return typeof t === 'string' && t; }).slice(0, MAX) : []; })
                    .catch(function () { return []; });
            }
            return trendingPromise;
        }

        function read() {
            try {
                var a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
                return Array.isArray(a) ? a.filter(function (t) { return typeof t === 'string' && t; }).slice(0, MAX) : [];
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }

        function write(a) {
            try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(a.slice(0, MAX))); } catch (e) {}
        }

        function add(term) {
            term = String(term || '').trim().slice(0, 80);
            if (!term) return;
            var lower = term.toLowerCase();
            var a = read().filter(function (t) { return t.toLowerCase() !== lower; });
            a.unshift(term);
            write(a);
        }

        function remove(term) {
            write(read().filter(function (t) { return t !== term; }));
        }

        // mode 'recent' (clock, X per row, Clear) or 'trending' (flame, read-only)
        function fill(panel, items, mode) {
            var list = panel.querySelector('.search-recent-list');
            var head = panel.querySelector('.search-recent-head > span');
            list.textContent = '';
            panel.classList.toggle('is-trending', mode === 'trending');
            if (head) head.textContent = mode === 'trending' ? 'Trending' : 'Recent';
            items.forEach(function (term) {
                var li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'search-recent-item';
                var a = document.createElement('a');
                a.className = 'search-recent-link';
                a.href = SEARCH_URL + '?s=' + encodeURIComponent(term);
                var icon = document.createElement('i');
                icon.className = mode === 'trending' ? 'fas fa-arrow-trend-up' : 'far fa-clock';
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                span.className = 'search-recent-term';
                span.textContent = term;
                a.appendChild(icon);
                a.appendChild(span);
                var rm = document.createElement('button');
                rm.type = 'button';
                rm.className = 'search-recent-remove';
                rm.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove from recent searches');
                rm.dataset.recentRemove = term;
                var x = document.createElement('i');
                x.className = 'fas fa-xmark';
                rm.appendChild(x);
                li.appendChild(a);
                if (mode !== 'trending') li.appendChild(rm);
                list.appendChild(li);
            });
            panel.hidden = items.length === 0;
            return items.length;
        }

        // Recents first; with none, the trending tags fill the box instead.
        // Returns the recent count synchronously (the trending fill lands
        // when the fetch does, and only if the box is still empty).
        function render(panel) {
            var items = read();
            var n = fill(panel, items, 'recent');
            if (!n) {
                var token = (panel._token = (panel._token || 0) + 1);
                loadTrending().then(function (terms) {
                    if (panel._token !== token || read().length) return;
                    fill(panel, terms, 'trending');
                });
            }
            return n;
        }

        var panels = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.search-recent'));
        var mobilePanel = document.getElementById('mobile-search-recent');
        var mobileTrending = document.getElementById('mobile-search-trending');
        var desktopPanel = document.getElementById('desktop-search-recent');
        var guide = document.getElementById('search-arrow-guide');
        var TRENDING_ON_PHONE = 5; // under up to 8 recents, both fit without scrolling

        // Phone overlay: recents (if any) and a short trending block, both
        // at once. The desktop dropdown stays recents-only with trending as
        // its empty-state fallback (see render()): a dropdown under a
        // field should stay short. The arrow guide shows only when both
        // blocks are empty.
        function renderMobile() {
            if (!mobilePanel) return;
            var n = fill(mobilePanel, read(), 'recent');
            if (guide) guide.style.display = n ? 'none' : '';
            if (!mobileTrending) return;
            loadTrending().then(function (terms) {
                var t = fill(mobileTrending, terms.slice(0, TRENDING_ON_PHONE), 'trending');
                if (guide) guide.style.display = (read().length || t) ? 'none' : '';
            });
        }

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('form.js-search-form'), function (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
                var input = form.querySelector('input[name="s"]');

<script>
    // Chatroom viewer counts. Fetched rather than server-rendered so the
    // number stays correct on FastCGI-cached pages. Response is public and
    // cached 15s, so most page loads never reach PHP at all.
    (function() {
        // Only pills still awaiting a value. Logged-in pages server-render
        // the count (no is-loading), so this fetch is guest-only — and on
        // the room page it can't overwrite the fresher number the room's
        // own setOnline() pushes into the current room's pill.
        const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-live[data-room].is-loading');
        if (!pills.length) return;

        function compact(n) {
            n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
            const units = [
                [1e12, 'T'],
                [1e9, 'B'],
                [1e6, 'M'],
                [1e3, 'K']
            ];
            for (const [div, suffix] of units) {
                if (n >= div) {
                    const v = n / div;
                    return (v >= 100 ? Math.round(v) : String(v.toFixed(1)).replace(/\.0$/, '')) + suffix;
                }
            }
            return String(n);
        }

        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/chatroom/api/counts', {
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                if (!d.success) return;
                pills.forEach(p => {
                    const n = parseInt(d.counts[p.dataset.room] ?? 0, 10) || 0;
                    p.querySelector('.sidebar-live-num').textContent = compact(n);
                    p.classList.toggle('is-zero', n === 0);
                    p.classList.remove('is-loading');
                });
            })
            .catch(() => {
                // Leave the pills hidden rather than showing a wrong number.
            });
    })();
</script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            var apiUrl = 'https://sarapbabe.com/api/views/';

            function fv(n) {
                if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
                if (n >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
                return n.toString();
            }

            function load() {
                var b = document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug]:not(.is-loaded)');
                if (!b.length) return;
                var s = [],
                    m = {};
                b.forEach(function(e) {
                    var slug = e.getAttribute('data-slug');
                    if (slug && !m[slug]) {
                        m[slug] = 1;
                        s.push(slug);
                    }
                });
                if (!s.length) return;
                fetch(apiUrl + '?slugs=' + encodeURIComponent(s.join(',')), {
                        method: 'GET',
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache'
                        }
                    })
                    .then(function(r) {
                        return r.json();
                    })
                    .then(function(d) {
                        Object.keys(d).forEach(function(slug) {
                            document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug="' + slug + '"]')
                                .forEach(function(badge) {
                                    var vc = badge.querySelector('.vc');
                                    if (vc) vc.textContent = fv(d[slug]);
                                    badge.classList.add('is-loaded');
                                });
                        });
                    })
                    .catch(function() {});
            }
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                    setTimeout(load, 50);
                });
            } else {
                setTimeout(load, 50);
            }
            window.refreshViews = load;
        })();
    </script>

                font-size: 13px;
            }

            /* Modal */
            .rcm-overlay {
                display: none;
                position: fixed;
                top: 0;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
                bottom: 0;
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
                z-index: 10000;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                padding: 1rem;
            }

            .rcm-overlay.show {
                display: flex;
            }

            .rcm-modal {
                background: #fff;
                border-radius: 18px;
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 480px;
                max-height: 80vh;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
                animation: slideUp 0.25s ease;
            }

            @media screen and (max-width: 768px) {
                .rcm-overlay {
                    align-items: flex-end;
                    padding: 0;
                }

                .rcm-modal {
                    max-width: 100%;
                    max-height: 85vh;
                    border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
                    animation: sheetUp 0.3s ease;
                }

                .rcm-sheet-handle {
                    display: block !important;
                }

                .rcm-modal-close {
                    display: none !important;
                }

                @keyframes sheetUp {
                    from {
                        transform: translateY(100%);
                    }

                    to {
                        transform: translateY(0);
                    }
                }
            }

            .rcm-modal-header {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: space-between;
                padding: 1rem 1.1rem 0.65rem;
                flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            .rcm-modal-header h3 {
                font-size: 15px;
                font-weight: 600;
                letter-spacing: -0.01em;
                color: #1f1f1f;
                margin: 0;
            }

            .rcm-modal-close {
                background: none;
                border: none;
                font-size: 1.2rem;
                color: #888;
                cursor: pointer;
                padding: 0.25rem;
            }

            .rcm-modal-close:hover {
                color: #333;
            }

            .rcm-modal-list {
                overflow-y: auto;
                flex: 1;
                padding: 0 0.7rem 0.6rem;
                -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
                scrollbar-width: thin;
                scrollbar-color: #e2e2e2 transparent;
            }

            .rcm-modal-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
                width: 4px;
            }

            .rcm-modal-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
                background: #e2e2e2;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }

            .rcm-modal-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
                background: #cfcfcf;
            }

            .rcm-modal-list .rcw-item {
                padding: 0.7rem 0.6rem;
            }

            .rcm-loading-more {

                color: #c4c4c4;

            </div>
            <div class="rcm-modal-list" id="rcmList"></div>
            <div class="rcm-loading-more" id="rcmLoadMore"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</div>
        </div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            let rcwLoaded = false;
            let rcmPage = 1;
            let rcmHasMore = false;
            let rcmLoading = false;

            function rcwEscape(text) {
                if (!text) return '';
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.textContent = String(text);
                return d.innerHTML;
            }

            function rcwTimeAgo(dt) {
                const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dt)) / 1000);
                if (diff < 60) return 'now';
                if (diff < 3600) return Math.floor(diff / 60) + 'm';
                if (diff < 86400) return Math.floor(diff / 3600) + 'h';
                if (diff < 604800) return Math.floor(diff / 86400) + 'd';
                return new Date(dt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
                    month: 'short',
                    day: 'numeric'
                });
            }

            function rcwRenderItem(c) {
                const initial = (c.username || '?')[0].toUpperCase();
                const avatar = c.avatar ?
                    `<img src="${rcwEscape(c.avatar)}" alt="" loading="lazy">` :
                    rcwEscape(initial);
                const text = rcwEscape(c.comment || '').substring(0, 120);
                const postTitle = rcwEscape(c.post_title || 'Untitled');
                const slug = c.post_slug || '';
                const commentId = parseInt(c.id, 10);

                return `<a href="https://sarapbabe.com/${slug}/#comment-${commentId}" class="rcw-item">
                <div class="rcw-avatar">${avatar}</div>
                <div class="rcw-body">
                    <div class="rcw-meta">
                        <span class="rcw-username">@${rcwEscape(c.username)}</span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span>${rcwTimeAgo(c.created_at)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="rcw-text">${text}</div>
                    <div class="rcw-post-title">${postTitle}</div>
                </div>
            </a>`;
            }

            function loadSidebarComments() {
                if (rcwLoaded) return;
                rcwLoaded = true;

                fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/api/recent-comments/?limit=5')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('rcwList');
                        if (!data.success || !data.comments || data.comments.length === 0) {
                            document.getElementById('recentCommentsWidget').style.display = 'none';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = data.comments.map(rcwRenderItem).join('');
                        document.getElementById('rcwSeeMore').style.display = '';
                    })
                    .catch(() => {
                        document.getElementById('rcwList').innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">Failed to load</div>';
                    });
            }

            window.openRecentCommentsModal = function() {
                rcmPage = 1;
                const overlay = document.getElementById('rcmOverlay');
                const list = document.getElementById('rcmList');
                overlay.classList.add('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:#c4c4c4;"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i></div>';
                loadModalComments(false);
            };

            window.closeRecentCommentsModal = function() {
                document.getElementById('rcmOverlay').classList.remove('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            };

            async function loadModalComments(append) {
                if (rcmLoading) return;
                rcmLoading = true;
                const loadMore = document.getElementById('rcmLoadMore');
                if (append) loadMore.style.display = 'block';

                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`https://sarapbabe.com/api/recent-comments/?limit=20&page=${rcmPage}`);
                    const data = await res.json();
                    const list = document.getElementById('rcmList');

                    if (data.success && data.comments.length > 0) {
                        const html = data.comments.map(rcwRenderItem).join('');
                        if (append) {
                            list.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
                        } else {
                            list.innerHTML = html;
                        }
                        rcmHasMore = data.has_more;
                        rcmPage++;
                    } else if (!append) {
                        list.innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">No comments yet</div>';
                        rcmHasMore = false;
                    } else {
                        rcmHasMore = false;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (!append) {
                        document.getElementById('rcmList').innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">Failed to load</div>';
                    }
                }

                loadMore.style.display = 'none';
                rcmLoading = false;
            }

            document.getElementById('rcmList')?.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
                if (rcmLoading || !rcmHasMore) return;
                if (this.scrollTop + this.clientHeight >= this.scrollHeight - 80) {
                    loadModalComments(true);
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('rcmOverlay')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closeRecentCommentsModal();
            });
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('rcmOverlay')?.classList.contains('show')) {
                    closeRecentCommentsModal();
                }
            });

            // Swipe down to dismiss on mobile
            (function() {
                var modal = document.querySelector('.rcm-modal');
                var handle = document.querySelector('.rcm-sheet-handle');
                if (!modal || !handle) return;
                var startY = 0,
                    currentY = 0,
                    dragging = false;

                var header = document.querySelector('.rcm-modal-header');
                [handle, header].forEach(function(el) {
                    if (!el) return;
                    el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                        startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                        currentY = 0;
                        dragging = true;
                        modal.style.transition = 'none';
                    }, {
                        passive: true
                    });

                    el.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
                        if (!dragging) return;
                        currentY = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
                        if (currentY > 0) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            modal.style.transform = 'translateY(' + currentY + 'px)';
                        }
                    }, {
                        passive: false
                    });

                    el.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
                        if (!dragging) return;
                        dragging = false;
                        modal.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease';
                        if (currentY > 100) {
                            modal.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                closeRecentCommentsModal();
                                modal.style.transform = '';
                                modal.style.transition = '';
                            }, 250);
                        } else {
                            modal.style.transform = '';
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                modal.style.transition = '';
                            }, 250);
                        }
                    });
                });
            })();

            // Move modal to body so it's not trapped inside is-hidden-touch aside
            var rcmOverlay = document.getElementById('rcmOverlay');
            if (rcmOverlay) {
                document.body.appendChild(rcmOverlay);
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadSidebarComments);
            } else {
                setTimeout(loadSidebarComments, 500);
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Auto-close notifications
            (document.querySelectorAll('.notification .delete') || []).forEach(($delete) => {
                const $notification = $delete.parentNode;
                $delete.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    $notification.parentNode.removeChild($notification);
                });
            });

            // Initialize sidebar state on desktop
            const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
            const body = document.body;

            if (desktopSidebar && window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                body.classList.add('has-sidebar');

                // Sync with initial state set in <head>
                const wasInitiallyCollapsed = document.documentElement.classList.contains('sidebar-initial-collapsed');
                if (wasInitiallyCollapsed || localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                }
            }

            // Enable transitions after initial state is set (double RAF for safety)
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    body.classList.remove('no-transition');
                    body.classList.add('transitions-enabled');
                });
            });
        });

        // Sidebar toggle - Desktop collapses, Mobile opens
        function toggleSidebar() {
            const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
            const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
            const body = document.body;

            if (isDesktop && desktopSidebar) {
                // Desktop: Toggle collapse state
                if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                    body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
                } else {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
                }
            } else if (mobileSidebar) {
                // Mobile: Open sidebar
                mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
                if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
                body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        }

        function closeMobileSidebar() {
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');

            if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }

        function openMobileSearch() {
            const searchOverlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
            if (searchOverlay) {
                searchOverlay.classList.add('is-active');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

                // Focus search input after animation
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const input = searchOverlay.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
                    if (input) input.focus();
                }, 300);
            }
        }

        // closeMobileSearch() lives in partials/header-nav.php (it also clears
        // the field and resets the clear-X); a copy here used to load later
        // and override it, so Cancel left the text behind.

        // Close mobile sidebar on escape key
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeMobileSidebar();
                closeMobileSearch();
            }
        });

        // Close mobile sidebar on window resize to desktop
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                closeMobileSidebar();
            }
        });
    </script>

<script>
    (function() {
        var modal = document.getElementById('externalLinkModal');
        if (!modal) return;
        var urlDisplay = document.getElementById('externalLinkUrl');
        var cancelBtn = document.getElementById('externalLinkCancel');
        var continueBtn = document.getElementById('externalLinkContinue');
        var scamWhere = document.getElementById('externalLinkScamWhere');
        var scamVia = document.getElementById('externalLinkScamVia');
        var pendingUrl = null;
        var COUNTDOWN = 5; // seconds Continue stays locked
        var continueLabel = continueBtn.innerHTML;
        var countdownTimer = null;

        // Name the messaging app in the scam warning when we recognize it.
        // Returns '' when the host is not a known messaging app; the "on X"
        // clause is then hidden. Matches the exact domain or a subdomain only,
        // so look-alikes such as notwhatsapp.com are not labeled as the real app.
        function scamChannelName(url) {
            var host = '';
            try { host = new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
            function is(d) { return host === d || host.slice(-(d.length + 1)) === '.' + d; }
            if (is('t.me') || is('telegram.me') || is('telegram.org')) return 'Telegram';
            if (is('wa.me') || is('whatsapp.com')) return 'WhatsApp';
            if (is('fb.com') || is('m.me') || is('facebook.com')) return 'Facebook';
            if (is('instagram.com')) return 'Instagram';
            return '';
        }

        function stopCountdown() {
            if (countdownTimer) { clearInterval(countdownTimer); countdownTimer = null; }
            continueBtn.disabled = false;
            continueBtn.innerHTML = continueLabel;
        }

        function startCountdown() {
            stopCountdown();
            var left = COUNTDOWN;
            var tick = function() {
                continueBtn.textContent = 'Continue (' + left + ')';
                if (left <= 0) { stopCountdown(); return; }
                left--;
            };
            continueBtn.disabled = true;
            tick();
            countdownTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
        }

        function closeModal() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            pendingUrl = null;
            stopCountdown();
        }
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        continueBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (pendingUrl) window.open(pendingUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
            closeModal();
        });
        modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.style.display === 'block') closeModal();
        });
        // curated: true for links the site owner placed (sidebar custom links);
        // they get the plain notice. Everything else is treated as user content.
        // Display only: pendingUrl keeps the full link (referral path/query
        // included) for Continue. Curated links show the bare domain so an
        // owner referral such as /@username never appears in the notice;
        // user-posted links keep the path so members can see where they go.
        window.showExternalLinkWarning = function(url, curated) {
            pendingUrl = url;
            try {
                var u = new URL(url);
                urlDisplay.textContent = curated ? u.hostname : u.hostname + u.pathname;
            } catch (e) {
                urlDisplay.textContent = url;
            }
            var where = scamChannelName(url);
            if (scamWhere) scamWhere.textContent = where;
            if (scamVia) scamVia.hidden = (where === '');
            modal.classList.toggle('is-curated', !!curated);
            modal.style.display = 'block';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            if (curated) stopCountdown(); else startCountdown();
        };
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var link = e.target.closest('.external-link');
            if (!link) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            showExternalLinkWarning(link.getAttribute('data-url') || link.href, link.getAttribute('data-curated') === '1');
        });
    })();
</script>

        function check() {

            var want = y > window.innerHeight * 2;
            if (want !== shown) {
                shown = want;
                btn.classList.toggle('is-visible', shown);

        }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
            if (!ticking) {
                ticking = true;
                window.requestAnimationFrame(check);

        var resolver = null;
        var mode = 'confirm';
        var prevFocus = null;

        function open(opts, newMode) {

                okBtn.textContent = opts.confirmText || 'OK';
                okBtn.className = 'appdlg-btn ' + (opts.danger ? 'is-danger' : 'is-primary');
                cancelBtn.textContent = opts.cancelText || 'Cancel';
                cancelBtn.hidden = newMode === 'alert';
                inputEl.hidden = newMode !== 'prompt';
                wrap.hidden = false;
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                if (newMode === 'prompt') {
                    inputEl.value = opts.value || '';
                    inputEl.placeholder = opts.placeholder || '';
                    inputEl.focus();
                } else {
                    (newMode === 'alert' || opts.danger ? okBtn : cancelBtn).focus();
                }
            });
        }

        function settle(ok) {
            if (wrap.hidden && !resolver) return;
            wrap.hidden = true;
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            var r = resolver;
            resolver = null;
            if (prevFocus && prevFocus.focus) { try { prevFocus.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
            prevFocus = null;
            if (r) r(mode === 'prompt' ? (ok ? inputEl.value : null) : ok);
        }

        window.appConfirm = function (opts) { return open(opts, 'confirm'); };
        window.appAlert = function (opts) { return open(opts, 'alert').then(function () {}); };
        window.appPrompt = function (opts) { return open(opts, 'prompt'); };

        // ── Toasts ──
        var toastZone = document.getElementById('app-toasts');
        window.appToast = function (opts) {
            if (typeof opts === 'string') opts = { message: opts };
            opts = opts || {};
            if (!toastZone) return null;
            var t = document.createElement('div');
            t.className = 'apptoast' + (opts.type === 'error' ? ' is-error' : opts.type === 'success' ? ' is-success' : '');
            var text = document.createElement('span');
            text.className = 'apptoast-text';
            text.textContent = opts.message || '';
            t.appendChild(text);
            var timer = null;
            function dismiss() {
                if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
                timer = null;
                if (!t.parentNode) return;
                t.classList.add('is-leaving');
                setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 200);
            }
            if (opts.action && opts.action.label) {
                var b = document.createElement('button');
                b.type = 'button';
                b.className = 'apptoast-action';
                b.textContent = opts.action.label;
                b.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    dismiss();
                    try { if (typeof opts.action.onClick === 'function') opts.action.onClick(); } catch (e) {}

            // stack two "Couldn't connect" bars.

        // the optimistic state back; the Retry button re-runs the action.
        window.netFail = function (retry, message) {
            var offline = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine === false;
            return window.appToast({
                key: 'net',
                type: 'error',
                message: message || (offline ? "You're offline. Reconnect and tap Retry." : "Couldn't connect. Tap Retry."),
                action: typeof retry === 'function' ? { label: 'Retry', onClick: retry } : null
            });
        };

        inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); settle(true); }
        });

        wrap.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (e.target.closest('[data-close]')) settle(false);
        });
        okBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { settle(true); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && !wrap.hidden) settle(false);
        });

        // e.submitter fallback for older browsers
        var lastSubmitBtn = null;
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
            var b = e.target.closest('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"], button:not([type])');
            if (b && b.form) lastSubmitBtn = b;
        }, true);

        // Declarative confirms: intercept submits of [data-confirm] forms/buttons
        document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            var form = e.target;
            if (form.dataset.appConfirmed === '1') { delete form.dataset.appConfirmed; return; }
            var submitter = e.submitter || (lastSubmitBtn && lastSubmitBtn.form === form ? lastSubmitBtn : null);
            var src = (submitter && submitter.dataset.confirm !== undefined) ? submitter
                : (form.dataset.confirm !== undefined ? form : null);
            if (!src) return;
            e.preventDefault(); // admin global spinner checks defaultPrevented, so it stays off
            appConfirm({
                title: src.dataset.confirmTitle || 'Are you sure?',
                message: src.dataset.confirm,
                confirmText: src.dataset.confirmOk || 'Confirm',
                danger: src.dataset.confirmDanger !== undefined
            }).then(function (ok) {
                if (!ok) return;
                form.dataset.appConfirmed = '1';
                if (form.requestSubmit) form.requestSubmit(submitter || undefined);
                else form.submit();
            });

    // Display Mode rows in the header dropdowns call this. State lives on
    // <html> only; the switch pills are pure CSS keyed off that class, so
    // every toggle instance stays in sync with no per-pill JS. Instant,
    // client-side, idempotent — no busy state needed.
    function toggleSiteTheme() {
        var c = document.documentElement.classList;
        var dark = !c.contains('theme-dark');
        c.toggle('theme-dark', dark);
        c.toggle('theme-light', !dark);
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('siteDark', dark ? '1' : '0');
        } catch (e) {}
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-toggle]').forEach(function(b) {

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var dark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('theme-dark');
