<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
        const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        const body = document.body;

        // A layout can remove the desktop sidebar with display:none (the
        // DM pane in layouts/messages.php does). Toggling its collapsed
        // class then changes nothing visible — a dead burger — so fall
        // through to the drawer, which that layout un-hides on desktop.
        const desktopShown = desktopSidebar && getComputedStyle(desktopSidebar).display !== 'none';

        if (isDesktop && desktopShown) {
            if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
            } else {
                desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
            }
        } else if (mobileSidebar) {
            // One surface at a time: the drawer replaces any open dropdown.
            ['mobileUserDropdown', 'mobileMessagesDropdown', 'mobileNotificationDropdown'].forEach(function (id) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('is-active');
            });
            mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
            body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
    }

    function closeMobileSidebar() {
        const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
        if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }



    function closeMobileSearch() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            searchInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }
    }

    // ── Clear X on the search fields ──
    // Swaps the magnifier for an X while there is text; the X wipes the
    // field and keeps focus, so the keyboard stays up and the recents and
    // trending lists come back (the field's own input listeners run).
    (function () {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.search-clear-btn'), function (btn) {
            var control = btn.parentElement;
            var input = control.querySelector('input');
            if (!input) return;
            var sync = function () { control.classList.toggle('has-text', input.value.trim() !== ''); };
            input.addEventListener('input', sync);
            btn.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }); // keep focus
            btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                input.value = '';
                input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                input.focus();
            });
            sync();
        });
    })();

    // ── Recent searches ──
    // localStorage, this device only, newest first, 8 max. Saved on submit
    // of either search form; listed in the phone overlay when it opens and
    // under the desktop box on focus. Rows are built with textContent so a
    // stored term can never become markup. Every storage access is wrapped:
    // private windows and blocked site data make the accessor throw.
    (function () {
        var KEY = 'recentSearches';
        var MAX = 8;
        var SEARCH_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search";
        var TRENDING_URL = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/search\/trending";
        var trendingPromise = null; // fetched once per page, only when a box opens empty

        function loadTrending() {
            if (!trendingPromise) {
                trendingPromise = fetch(TRENDING_URL, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
                    .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : { terms: [] }; })
                    .then(function (d) { return Array.isArray(d.terms) ? d.terms.filter(function (t) { return typeof t === 'string' && t; }).slice(0, MAX) : []; })
                    .catch(function () { return []; });
            }
            return trendingPromise;
        }

        function read() {
            try {
                var a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
                return Array.isArray(a) ? a.filter(function (t) { return typeof t === 'string' && t; }).slice(0, MAX) : [];
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }

        function write(a) {
            try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(a.slice(0, MAX))); } catch (e) {}
        }

        function add(term) {
            term = String(term || '').trim().slice(0, 80);
            if (!term) return;
            var lower = term.toLowerCase();
            var a = read().filter(function (t) { return t.toLowerCase() !== lower; });
            a.unshift(term);
            write(a);
        }

        function remove(term) {
            write(read().filter(function (t) { return t !== term; }));
        }

        // mode 'recent' (clock, X per row, Clear) or 'trending' (flame, read-only)
        function fill(panel, items, mode) {
            var list = panel.querySelector('.search-recent-list');
            var head = panel.querySelector('.search-recent-head > span');
            list.textContent = '';
            panel.classList.toggle('is-trending', mode === 'trending');
            if (head) head.textContent = mode === 'trending' ? 'Trending' : 'Recent';
            items.forEach(function (term) {
                var li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = 'search-recent-item';
                var a = document.createElement('a');
                a.className = 'search-recent-link';
                a.href = SEARCH_URL + '?s=' + encodeURIComponent(term);
                var icon = document.createElement('i');
                icon.className = mode === 'trending' ? 'fas fa-arrow-trend-up' : 'far fa-clock';
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                span.className = 'search-recent-term';
                span.textContent = term;
                a.appendChild(icon);
                a.appendChild(span);
                var rm = document.createElement('button');
                rm.type = 'button';
                rm.className = 'search-recent-remove';
                rm.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove from recent searches');
                rm.dataset.recentRemove = term;
                var x = document.createElement('i');
                x.className = 'fas fa-xmark';
                rm.appendChild(x);
                li.appendChild(a);
                if (mode !== 'trending') li.appendChild(rm);
                list.appendChild(li);
            });
            panel.hidden = items.length === 0;
            return items.length;
        }

        // Recents first; with none, the trending tags fill the box instead.
        // Returns the recent count synchronously (the trending fill lands
        // when the fetch does, and only if the box is still empty).
        function render(panel) {
            var items = read();
            var n = fill(panel, items, 'recent');
            if (!n) {
                var token = (panel._token = (panel._token || 0) + 1);
                loadTrending().then(function (terms) {
                    if (panel._token !== token || read().length) return;
                    fill(panel, terms, 'trending');
                });
            }
            return n;
        }

        var panels = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.search-recent'));
        var mobilePanel = document.getElementById('mobile-search-recent');
        var mobileTrending = document.getElementById('mobile-search-trending');
        var desktopPanel = document.getElementById('desktop-search-recent');
        var guide = document.getElementById('search-arrow-guide');
        var TRENDING_ON_PHONE = 5; // under up to 8 recents, both fit without scrolling

        // Phone overlay: recents (if any) and a short trending block, both
        // at once. The desktop dropdown stays recents-only with trending as
        // its empty-state fallback (see render()): a dropdown under a
        // field should stay short. The arrow guide shows only when both
        // blocks are empty.
        function renderMobile() {
            if (!mobilePanel) return;
            var n = fill(mobilePanel, read(), 'recent');
            if (guide) guide.style.display = n ? 'none' : '';
            if (!mobileTrending) return;
            loadTrending().then(function (terms) {
                var t = fill(mobileTrending, terms.slice(0, TRENDING_ON_PHONE), 'trending');
                if (guide) guide.style.display = (read().length || t) ? 'none' : '';
            });
        }

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('form.js-search-form'), function (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
                var input = form.querySelector('input[name="s"]');
                if (input) add(input.value);
            });
        });

        panels.forEach(function (panel) {
            panel.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var rm = e.target.closest('[data-recent-remove]');
                if (rm) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    remove(rm.dataset.recentRemove);
                    if (panel === mobilePanel) renderMobile(); else render(panel);
                    return;
                }
                if (e.target.closest('[data-recent-clear]')) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    write([]);
                    if (panel === mobilePanel) renderMobile(); else render(panel);
                }
            });
            // Keep the desktop input focused while clicking inside the panel.

            });
        });

        // Phone overlay: render whenever it opens (its opener toggles
        // is-active; observing the class keeps this out of that handler).
        var overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
        if (overlay && window.MutationObserver) {
            new MutationObserver(function () {
                if (overlay.classList.contains('is-active')) renderMobile();
            }).observe(overlay, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

        // Desktop box: show on focus, hide on outside click / Escape / typing.
        var desktopForm = desktopPanel ? desktopPanel.closest('form') : null;
        var desktopInput = desktopForm ? desktopForm.querySelector('input[name="s"]') : null;
        if (desktopInput) {
            desktopInput.addEventListener('focus', function () { if (!desktopInput.value) render(desktopPanel); });
            desktopInput.addEventListener('input', function () { if (desktopInput.value) desktopPanel.hidden = true; else render(desktopPanel); });
            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!desktopForm.contains(e.target)) desktopPanel.hidden = true; });
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') desktopPanel.hidden = true; });
        }

        window.recentSearches = { add: add, read: read };

    // Add event listener
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

        const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');

                if (arrowGuide) {

                // Focus MUST happen in same event - this is the key!
                searchInput.focus();
            });

        // Keep the arrow animation logic
        if (searchInput && arrowGuide) {

    // Notification system
    var notifCsrfToken = "24f42f9395a3b8fd8a3351b1445e000bc1941cb68bc12f0b244d58cb413d5bd4";
    let notificationsOpen = false;
    let notificationsLoaded = false;

    function closeDesktopNotifications() {
        const list = document.getElementById('notificationList');
        if (list) list.style.display = 'none';
        notificationsOpen = false;
    }

    function toggleNotifications(e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        const dropdown = document.getElementById('notificationList');

    let mobileNotificationsLoaded = false;

    // Notification data: one cache per filter, shared by desktop and mobile.
    // 'unread' is fetched server-side (unread_only=1) so it isn't limited to
    // whatever happens to sit in the newest 20 rows of 'all'.
    let notifFilter = 'all';
    let notifCache = { all: null, unread: null };

    function invalidateNotifCache() {
        notifCache = { all: null, unread: null };
        notificationsLoaded = false;
        mobileNotificationsLoaded = false;
    }

    function setNotifFilter(filter, ev) {
        if (ev) { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); }
        if (notifFilter === filter) return;
        notifFilter = filter;
        document.querySelectorAll('.notif-tab').forEach(btn => {
            btn.classList.toggle('is-active', btn.getAttribute('data-notif-filter') === filter);
        });
        loadNotifFilter();
    }

    function fetchNotifData(filter) {
        if (notifCache[filter]) return Promise.resolve(notifCache[filter]);
        const url = 'https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/' + (filter === 'unread' ? '?unread_only=1' : '');
        return fetch(url)
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                notifCache[filter] = data.notifications || [];
                if (typeof data.unread_count === 'number') updateNotificationBadge(data.unread_count);
                return notifCache[filter];
            });
    }

    function loadNotifFilter() {
        const desktop = document.getElementById('notificationItems');
        const mobile = document.getElementById('mobileNotificationItems');
        if (!notifCache[notifFilter]) {
            const spinner = '<div class="dropdown-item has-text-centered has-text-grey py-4"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i></div>';
            if (desktop) desktop.innerHTML = spinner;
            if (mobile) mobile.innerHTML = spinner;
        }
        fetchNotifData(notifFilter)
            .then(() => {
                notificationsLoaded = true;
                mobileNotificationsLoaded = true;
                renderNotifSurfaces();
            })
            .catch(() => {
                const fail = '<div class="dropdown-item has-text-centered has-text-danger">Failed to load</div>';
                if (desktop) desktop.innerHTML = fail;
                if (mobile) mobile.innerHTML = fail;
            });
    }

    function loadNotifications() { loadNotifFilter(); }
    function loadMobileNotifications() { loadNotifFilter(); }

    function notifEmptyHtml() {
        if (notifFilter === 'unread') {
            return '<div class="notif-empty is-caught-up"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg>You\'re all caught up</div>';

        return '<div class="notif-empty"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8.7 3A6 6 0 0 1 18 8a21.3 21.3 0 0 0 .6 5"/><path d="M17 17H3s3-2 3-9a4.67 4.67 0 0 1 .3-1.7"/><path d="M10.3 21a1.94 1.94 0 0 0 3.4 0"/><path d="m2 2 20 20"/></svg>No notifications</div>';
    }

    function notifRowHtml(n, mobile) {
        if (mobile) {
            return `
                <a href="${escapeHtml(n.link || '#')}" class="dropdown-item notification-item ${n.is_read ? '' : 'is-unread'}"
                   onclick="markNotificationRead(${n.id})"
                   style="white-space: normal; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center;">
                    ${notifAvatar(n)}
                    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
                        <div style="font-weight: ${n.is_read ? 'normal' : '600'}; font-size: 0.85rem;">${escapeHtml(n.title)}</div>
                        ${n.message ? `<div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888; margin-top: 2px;">${escapeHtml(n.message)}</div>` : ''}
                        <div style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: #aaa; margin-top: 2px;">${n.time_ago}</div>
                    </div>
                </a>`;
        }
        return `
            <a href="${escapeHtml(n.link || '#')}" class="dropdown-item notification-item ${n.is_read ? '' : 'is-unread'}"
               onclick="markNotificationRead(${n.id})" style="white-space: normal; padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center;">
                    ${notifAvatar(n)}
                    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
                        <div style="font-weight: ${n.is_read ? 'normal' : '600'};">${escapeHtml(n.title)}</div>
                        ${n.message ? `<div class="is-size-7 has-text-grey" style="margin-top: 2px;">${escapeHtml(n.message)}</div>` : ''}
                        <div class="is-size-7 has-text-grey" style="margin-top: 4px;">${n.time_ago}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

    }

    function renderNotifSurfaces() {
        const list = notifCache[notifFilter];
        if (!list) return;
        const desktop = document.getElementById('notificationItems');
        const mobile = document.getElementById('mobileNotificationItems');
        if (desktop) desktop.innerHTML = list.length ? list.map(n => notifRowHtml(n, false)).join('') : notifEmptyHtml();
        if (mobile) mobile.innerHTML = list.length ? list.slice(0, 8).map(n => notifRowHtml(n, true)).join('') : notifEmptyHtml();
        // "Clear all" clears everything, so it stays visible while ANY
        // notifications exist — even when the unread view is empty.
        const hasAny = notifCache.all ? notifCache.all.length > 0 : list.length > 0;
        const desktopClear = document.getElementById('notificationClearAll');
        if (desktopClear) desktopClear.style.display = hasAny ? 'block' : 'none';
        const mobileClear = document.getElementById('mobileNotificationClearAll');
        if (mobileClear) mobileClear.style.display = hasAny ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    function getNotificationIcon(type) {
        const icons = {
            'comment': '<span class="icon has-text-info"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.9 20A9 9 0 1 0 4 16.1L2 22Z"/></svg></span>',
            'like': '<span class="icon has-text-danger"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 14c1.49-1.46 3-3.21 3-5.5A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 16.5 3c-1.76 0-3 .5-4.5 2-1.5-1.5-2.74-2-4.5-2A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 2 8.5c0 2.3 1.5 4.05 3 5.5l7 7Z"/></svg></span>',
            'follow': '<span class="icon has-text-success"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><line x1="19" x2="19" y1="8" y2="14"/><line x1="22" x2="16" y1="11" y2="11"/></svg></span>',
            'system': '<span class="icon has-text-warning"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 8a6 6 0 0 1 12 0c0 7 3 9 3 9H3s3-2 3-9"/><path d="M10.3 21a1.94 1.94 0 0 0 3.4 0"/></svg></span>',
            'premium': '<span class="icon has-text-warning"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11.562 3.266a.5.5 0 0 1 .876 0L15.39 8.87a1 1 0 0 0 1.516.294L21.183 5.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .798.519l-2.834 10.246a1 1 0 0 1-.956.734H5.81a1 1 0 0 1-.957-.734L2.02 6.02a.5.5 0 0 1 .798-.519l4.276 3.664a1 1 0 0 0 1.516-.294z"/><path d="M5 21h14"/></svg></span>',
            'message': '<span class="icon has-text-primary"><svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="20" height="16" x="2" y="4" rx="2"/><path d="m22 7-8.97 5.7a1.94 1.94 0 0 1-2.06 0L2 7"/></svg></span>'
        };
        return icons[type] || icons['system'];
    }

    // textContent -> innerHTML does NOT escape quotes, and this function's
    // output is interpolated into href=""/src="" attributes below. Escape
    // quotes explicitly so an attribute can never be broken out of.
    function getNotificationBadge(type) {
        const map = {
            'comment': ['<svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.9 20A9 9 0 1 0 4 16.1L2 22Z"/></svg>', '#3b82f6'],
            'like': ['<svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 14c1.49-1.46 3-3.21 3-5.5A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 16.5 3c-1.76 0-3 .5-4.5 2-1.5-1.5-2.74-2-4.5-2A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 2 8.5c0 2.3 1.5 4.05 3 5.5l7 7Z"/></svg>', '#ef4444'],
            'follow': ['<svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><line x1="19" x2="19" y1="8" y2="14"/><line x1="22" x2="16" y1="11" y2="11"/></svg>', '#10b981'],
            'message': ['<svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="20" height="16" x="2" y="4" rx="2"/><path d="m22 7-8.97 5.7a1.94 1.94 0 0 1-2.06 0L2 7"/></svg>', '#0d9488'],
            'new_video': ['<svg class="ui-ic" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m16 13 5.223 3.482a.5.5 0 0 0 .777-.416V7.87a.5.5 0 0 0-.752-.432L16 10.5"/><rect x="2" y="6" width="14" height="12" rx="2"/></svg>', '#8b5cf6']
        };
        const b = map[type];
        if (!b) return '';
        return `<span class="notif-badge" style="background:${b[1]};">${b[0]}</span>`;

    function notifAvatar(n) {
        // System rows have no sender — fall back to the type glyph.
        if (!n.from_username) {
            return `<div class="notif-ava is-system">${getNotificationIcon(n.type)}</div>`;
        }
        const base = 'https://sarapbabe.com/'.replace(/\/$/, '');
        const src = n.from_avatar ?
            (n.from_avatar.startsWith('http') ? n.from_avatar : base + n.from_avatar) : '';
        const inner = src ?
            `<img src="${escapeHtml(src)}" alt="">` :
            escapeHtml(String(n.from_username).substring(0, 2).toUpperCase());
        return `<div class="notif-ava">${inner}${getNotificationBadge(n.type)}</div>`;
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text ?? '')
            .replace(/&/g, '&')
            .replace(/</g, '<')
            .replace(/>/g, '>')
            .replace(/"/g, '"')
            .replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    function markNotificationRead(id) {
        if (notifCache.all) {
            const hit = notifCache.all.find(n => n.id === id);
            if (hit) hit.is_read = true;
        }
        if (notifCache.unread) {
            notifCache.unread = notifCache.unread.filter(n => n.id !== id);
        }
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/mark-read/', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
            },
            body: 'id=' + id + '&csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
        });
    }

    function markAllNotificationsRead(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/mark-all-read/', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                body: 'csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
            })
            .then(() => {
                if (notifCache.all) notifCache.all.forEach(n => { n.is_read = true; });
                notifCache.unread = [];
                renderNotifSurfaces();
                updateNotificationBadge(0);
            });
    }

    function clearAllNotifications(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        const modal = document.getElementById('notifClearConfirm');
        if (modal) modal.hidden = false;
    }

    (function () {
        const modal = document.getElementById('notifClearConfirm');
        if (!modal) return;

        function closeNotifClearConfirm() { modal.hidden = true; }

        // stopPropagation keeps the dropdown behind the sheet open while
        // the user interacts with it (the document click-outside handlers
        // would otherwise close it under the backdrop).
        modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (e.target.closest('[data-close]')) closeNotifClearConfirm();
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) closeNotifClearConfirm();
        });

        document.getElementById('notifClearConfirmBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            closeNotifClearConfirm();
            fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/clear-all/', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                    },
                    body: 'csrf_token=' + encodeURIComponent(notifCsrfToken)
                })
                .then(() => {
                    notifCache.all = [];
                    notifCache.unread = [];
                    renderNotifSurfaces();
                    updateNotificationBadge(0);
                });
        });
    })();

    function updateNotificationBadge(count) {
        updateBadges(['notificationBadge', 'mobileNotificationBadge'], count);
        updateNotifTabCount(count);
    }

    function updateNotifTabCount(count) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.notif-tab-count').forEach(el => {
            el.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
            el.style.display = count > 0 ? '' : 'none';
        });
    }

    function fetchNotificationCount() {
        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/notifications/unread-count/')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                const newCount = data.count || 0;
                const badge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
                const oldCount = badge ? (parseInt(badge.textContent) || 0) : 0;

                updateNotificationBadge(newCount);

                // If count increased, drop the cache so the dropdown refreshes
                if (newCount > oldCount) {
                    invalidateNotifCache();
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (notificationsOpen) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('notificationDropdown');
            if (dropdown && !dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
                closeDesktopNotifications();
            }
        }
    });

    
    // Shared badge update helper
    function updateBadges(ids, count) {
        const displayCount = count > 99 ? '99+' : count;
        const display = count > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
        ids.forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) {
                el.textContent = displayCount;
                el.style.display = display;
            }
        });
    }
</script>

    /* Live viewer count on chatroom rows. The generic span:not(.icon) rule
       below sets margin-left:0.75rem and overflow:hidden — both wrong for a
       pill pushed to the far edge, so they're overridden here. The collapsed
       state still hides it, which is what we want (icons only). */
    /* Dot + number, no chip. The generic span:not(.icon) rule sets
       margin-left:0.75rem and overflow:hidden — both wrong for something
       pinned to the right edge, hence the overrides. */
    .sidebar-link .sidebar-live {
        margin-left: auto !important;
        margin-right: 2px;
        overflow: visible !important;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        color: #6b7280;
        font-size: 0.72rem !important;
        font-weight: 600 !important;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    /* Empty room = no pill at all. Owner decision: a grey dot + "0" reads
       as dead inventory — hide dot AND number and let the row stand alone.
       Every writer keeps is-zero in sync (server render, the guest fetch
       below, and the room page's setOnline), so this also un-hides live
       the moment someone joins. */
    .sidebar-link .sidebar-live.is-zero {
        display: none;
    }

    /* Active row is filled with the primary colour and its text goes white,
       so the fixed greys vanish into it. Inherit instead — the count picks
       up whatever the row is using. */
    .sidebar-link.is-active .sidebar-live {
        color: inherit;
        opacity: 0.85;
    }

    /* The dot stays GREEN on the active row — currentColor made "live" and
       "empty" indistinguishable while you're inside the room. No ring/border
       on it: owner tried one and vetoed it. */
    .sidebar-live-dot {
        width: 7px;
        height: 7px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #10b981;
        flex-shrink: 0;

    @media screen and (min-width: 1024px) {

    .sidebar-link .sidebar-count {

        margin-right: 2px;

    .sidebar-link .sidebar-live.is-loading,

<script>
    // Chatroom viewer counts. Fetched rather than server-rendered so the
    // number stays correct on FastCGI-cached pages. Response is public and
    // cached 15s, so most page loads never reach PHP at all.
    (function() {
        // Only pills still awaiting a value. Logged-in pages server-render
        // the count (no is-loading), so this fetch is guest-only — and on
        // the room page it can't overwrite the fresher number the room's
        // own setOnline() pushes into the current room's pill.
        const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-live[data-room].is-loading');
        if (!pills.length) return;

        function compact(n) {
            n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
            const units = [
                [1e12, 'T'],
                [1e9, 'B'],
                [1e6, 'M'],
                [1e3, 'K']
            ];
            for (const [div, suffix] of units) {
                if (n >= div) {
                    const v = n / div;
                    return (v >= 100 ? Math.round(v) : String(v.toFixed(1)).replace(/\.0$/, '')) + suffix;
                }
            }
            return String(n);
        }

        fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/chatroom/api/counts', {
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                if (!d.success) return;
                pills.forEach(p => {
                    const n = parseInt(d.counts[p.dataset.room] ?? 0, 10) || 0;
                    p.querySelector('.sidebar-live-num').textContent = compact(n);
                    p.classList.toggle('is-zero', n === 0);
                    p.classList.remove('is-loading');
                });
            })
            .catch(() => {
                // Leave the pills hidden rather than showing a wrong number.
            });
    })();

    <script>
        (function() {
            var apiUrl = 'https://sarapbabe.com/api/views/';

            function fv(n) {
                if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
                if (n >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
                return n.toString();
            }

            function load() {
                var b = document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug]:not(.is-loaded)');
                if (!b.length) return;
                var s = [],
                    m = {};
                b.forEach(function(e) {
                    var slug = e.getAttribute('data-slug');
                    if (slug && !m[slug]) {
                        m[slug] = 1;
                        s.push(slug);
                    }
                });
                if (!s.length) return;
                fetch(apiUrl + '?slugs=' + encodeURIComponent(s.join(',')), {
                        method: 'GET',
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache'
                        }
                    })
                    .then(function(r) {
                        return r.json();
                    })
                    .then(function(d) {
                        Object.keys(d).forEach(function(slug) {
                            document.querySelectorAll('.view-count-badge[data-slug="' + slug + '"]')
                                .forEach(function(badge) {
                                    var vc = badge.querySelector('.vc');
                                    if (vc) vc.textContent = fv(d[slug]);
                                    badge.classList.add('is-loaded');
                                });
                        });
                    })
                    .catch(function() {});
            }
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                    setTimeout(load, 50);
                });
            } else {
                setTimeout(load, 50);
            }
            window.refreshViews = load;
        })();
    </script>

            // pageload when >=50% visible. Ids are read from the served
            // (possibly edge-cached) DOM, so guests report exactly the ads
            // they were shown. CSS-hidden device variants never intersect.
            var beaconUrl = "https:\/\/sarapbabe.com\/api\/spot\/seen\/";
            var seen = {};
            var queue = [];
            var flushTimer = null;

            function flush() {
                flushTimer = null;
                if (!queue.length) return;
                var ids = queue.splice(0, 10).join(',');
                var fd = new FormData();
                fd.append('ids', ids);
                try {
                    var vid = localStorage.getItem('vid');
                    if (vid) fd.append('vid', vid);
                } catch (e) { /* storage blocked - server falls back to IP+UA */ }

                if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
                    navigator.sendBeacon(beaconUrl, fd);
                } else {
                    fetch(beaconUrl, { method: 'POST', body: fd, keepalive: true }).catch(function() {});
                }
                if (queue.length) flushTimer = setTimeout(flush, 500);
            }

            function report(id) {
                if (seen[id]) return;
                seen[id] = true;
                queue.push(id);
                if (!flushTimer) flushTimer = setTimeout(flush, 800);
            }

            // This script is emitted where the partial is first required —
            // usually BEFORE the ad markup — so wait for the full DOM.
            // arm(root) is also exposed as window.inadArm for cards that
            // arrive later (infinite scroll appends them from a fetched
            // page); report() de-duplicates by id, so re-arming is safe.
            function arm(root) {
                var scope = (root && root.querySelectorAll) ? root : document;
                var els = Array.prototype.slice.call(scope.querySelectorAll('[data-inad]'));

                if (!els.length) return;

                if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
                    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
                        entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                            if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5) {
                                report(entry.target.getAttribute('data-inad'));

                            }

                    els.forEach(function(el) { io.observe(el); });
                } else {

                    els.forEach(function(el) { report(el.getAttribute('data-inad')); });
                }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { arm(); });
            } else {
                arm();
            }

            <div class="recent-comments-widget" id="recentCommentsWidget">
            <div class="rcw-header">
                <span class="rcw-title">Recent Comments</span>
            </div>
            <div class="rcw-list" id="rcwList">
                <div class="rcw-loading"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i></div>
            </div>
            <button class="rcw-see-more" id="rcwSeeMore" style="display:none;" onclick="openRecentCommentsModal()">See more</button>

        <style>
            /* No icons, no dividers — rows separate by spacing and a soft hover
               fill. Type scale and the system font stack match the sort tabs on
               the index.

               Chromeless in the sidebar on purpose: post cards carry no
               container of their own (see post-card.php), so a bordered box
               here would be the heaviest thing on the page and would pull the
               eye off the feed. The sidebar column and its gutter already do
               the separating. */
            .recent-comments-widget {
                margin-top: 1.5rem;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
            }

            /* Mobile is the opposite case: the widget renders inline under the
               feed in the same column (layouts/main.php), so it needs a card to
               read as a separate block instead of more feed. */
            #recentCommentsWidgetMobile {
                padding: 0.85rem 0.6rem 0.8rem;
                background: #fff;
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.045);
                border-radius: 16px;
                box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
            }

            .rcw-header {
                padding: 0 0.55rem 0.55rem;
            }

            .rcw-title {
                font-weight: 600;
                font-size: 14px;
                letter-spacing: -0.01em;
                color: #1f1f1f;
            }

            .rcw-list {
                max-height: 360px;
                overflow-y: auto;
                scrollbar-width: thin;
                scrollbar-color: #e2e2e2 transparent;
            }

            .rcw-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
                width: 4px;
            }

            .rcw-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
                background: #e2e2e2;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }

            .rcw-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
                background: #cfcfcf;
            }

            .rcw-loading {
                text-align: center;
                padding: 1.5rem;
                color: #c4c4c4;
                font-size: 13px;
            }

            .rcw-item {
                display: flex;
                gap: 0.65rem;
                padding: 0.6rem 0.55rem;
                border-radius: 12px;
                text-decoration: none;
                color: inherit;
                transition: background 0.15s ease;
            }

            .rcw-item:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.035);
            }

            .rcw-avatar {
                width: 34px;
                height: 34px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                background: #f2f2f2;
                color: #b0b0b0;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                flex-shrink: 0;
                overflow: hidden;
            }

            .rcw-avatar img {
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
                object-fit: cover;
            }

            .rcw-body {
                flex: 1;
                min-width: 0;
            }

            .rcw-meta {
                font-size: 12px;
                color: #b3b3b3;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 0.35rem;
                margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
            }

            .rcw-username {
                font-weight: 600;
                color: #5a5a5a;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
            }

            .rcw-text {
                font-size: 13px;
                color: #2f2f2f;
                line-height: 1.5;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                display: -webkit-box;
                -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
                line-clamp: 2;
                -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            }

            .rcw-post-title {
                display: inline-block;
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-top: 0.35rem;
                padding: 2px 9px;
                border-radius: 999px;
                background: #f4f4f4;
                font-size: 11.5px;
                color: #8a8a8a;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
            }

            .rcw-item:hover .rcw-post-title {
                background: #ededed;
            }

            .rcw-see-more {
                display: block;
                margin: 0.55rem auto 0;
                padding: 7px 20px;
                background: #f4f4f4;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 999px;
                color: #6f6f6f;
                font-family: inherit;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                cursor: pointer;
                transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
            }

            .rcw-see-more:hover {
                background: #ececec;
                color: #333;
            }

            .rcw-empty {
                text-align: center;
                padding: 1.5rem;
                color: #c4c4c4;
                font-size: 13px;
            }

            /* Modal */
            .rcm-overlay {
                display: none;
                position: fixed;
                top: 0;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
                bottom: 0;
                background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
                z-index: 10000;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                padding: 1rem;
            }

            .rcm-overlay.show {
                display: flex;
            }

            .rcm-modal {
                background: #fff;
                border-radius: 18px;
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 480px;
                max-height: 80vh;
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;

                    align-items: flex-end;

                    max-height: 85vh;
                    border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;

                .rcm-sheet-handle {
                    display: block !important;

                .rcm-modal-close {
                    display: none !important;

                        transform: translateY(0);
                    }

                display: flex;

                justify-content: space-between;

            <div class="rcm-modal-header">
                <h3>Recent Comments</h3>
                <button class="rcm-modal-close" onclick="closeRecentCommentsModal()" style="width:32px;height:32px;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:#f4f4f4;"><i class="fas fa-times" style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#8a8a8a;"></i></button>
            </div>
            <div class="rcm-modal-list" id="rcmList"></div>
            <div class="rcm-loading-more" id="rcmLoadMore"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            let rcwLoaded = false;
            let rcmPage = 1;
            let rcmHasMore = false;
            let rcmLoading = false;

            function rcwEscape(text) {
                if (!text) return '';
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.textContent = String(text);
                return d.innerHTML;
            }

            function rcwTimeAgo(dt) {
                const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dt)) / 1000);
                if (diff < 60) return 'now';
                if (diff < 3600) return Math.floor(diff / 60) + 'm';
                if (diff < 86400) return Math.floor(diff / 3600) + 'h';
                if (diff < 604800) return Math.floor(diff / 86400) + 'd';
                return new Date(dt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
                    month: 'short',
                    day: 'numeric'
                });
            }

            function rcwRenderItem(c) {
                const initial = (c.username || '?')[0].toUpperCase();
                const avatar = c.avatar ?
                    `<img src="${rcwEscape(c.avatar)}" alt="" loading="lazy">` :
                    rcwEscape(initial);
                const text = rcwEscape(c.comment || '').substring(0, 120);
                const postTitle = rcwEscape(c.post_title || 'Untitled');
                const slug = c.post_slug || '';
                const commentId = parseInt(c.id, 10);

                return `<a href="https://sarapbabe.com/${slug}/#comment-${commentId}" class="rcw-item">
                <div class="rcw-avatar">${avatar}</div>
                <div class="rcw-body">
                    <div class="rcw-meta">
                        <span class="rcw-username">@${rcwEscape(c.username)}</span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span>${rcwTimeAgo(c.created_at)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="rcw-text">${text}</div>
                    <div class="rcw-post-title">${postTitle}</div>
                </div>
            </a>`;
            }

            function loadSidebarComments() {
                if (rcwLoaded) return;
                rcwLoaded = true;

                fetch('https://sarapbabe.com/api/recent-comments/?limit=5')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('rcwList');
                        if (!data.success || !data.comments || data.comments.length === 0) {
                            document.getElementById('recentCommentsWidget').style.display = 'none';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = data.comments.map(rcwRenderItem).join('');
                        document.getElementById('rcwSeeMore').style.display = '';
                    })
                    .catch(() => {
                        document.getElementById('rcwList').innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">Failed to load</div>';
                    });
            }

            window.openRecentCommentsModal = function() {
                rcmPage = 1;
                const overlay = document.getElementById('rcmOverlay');
                const list = document.getElementById('rcmList');
                overlay.classList.add('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:#c4c4c4;"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i></div>';
                loadModalComments(false);
            };

            window.closeRecentCommentsModal = function() {
                document.getElementById('rcmOverlay').classList.remove('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            };

            async function loadModalComments(append) {
                if (rcmLoading) return;
                rcmLoading = true;
                const loadMore = document.getElementById('rcmLoadMore');
                if (append) loadMore.style.display = 'block';

                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`https://sarapbabe.com/api/recent-comments/?limit=20&page=${rcmPage}`);
                    const data = await res.json();
                    const list = document.getElementById('rcmList');

                    if (data.success && data.comments.length > 0) {
                        const html = data.comments.map(rcwRenderItem).join('');
                        if (append) {
                            list.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
                        } else {
                            list.innerHTML = html;
                        }
                        rcmHasMore = data.has_more;
                        rcmPage++;
                    } else if (!append) {
                        list.innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">No comments yet</div>';
                        rcmHasMore = false;
                    } else {
                        rcmHasMore = false;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (!append) {
                        document.getElementById('rcmList').innerHTML = '<div class="rcw-empty">Failed to load</div>';
                    }
                }

                loadMore.style.display = 'none';
                rcmLoading = false;
            }

            document.getElementById('rcmList')?.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
                if (rcmLoading || !rcmHasMore) return;
                if (this.scrollTop + this.clientHeight >= this.scrollHeight - 80) {
                    loadModalComments(true);
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('rcmOverlay')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closeRecentCommentsModal();
            });
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('rcmOverlay')?.classList.contains('show')) {
                    closeRecentCommentsModal();
                }
            });

            // Swipe down to dismiss on mobile
            (function() {
                var modal = document.querySelector('.rcm-modal');
                var handle = document.querySelector('.rcm-sheet-handle');
                if (!modal || !handle) return;
                var startY = 0,
                    currentY = 0,
                    dragging = false;

                var header = document.querySelector('.rcm-modal-header');
                [handle, header].forEach(function(el) {
                    if (!el) return;
                    el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                        startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                        currentY = 0;
                        dragging = true;
                        modal.style.transition = 'none';
                    }, {
                        passive: true
                    });

                    el.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
                        if (!dragging) return;
                        currentY = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
                        if (currentY > 0) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            modal.style.transform = 'translateY(' + currentY + 'px)';
                        }
                    }, {
                        passive: false
                    });

                    el.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
                        if (!dragging) return;
                        dragging = false;
                        modal.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease';
                        if (currentY > 100) {
                            modal.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                closeRecentCommentsModal();
                                modal.style.transform = '';
                                modal.style.transition = '';
                            }, 250);
                        } else {
                            modal.style.transform = '';
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                modal.style.transition = '';
                            }, 250);
                        }
                    });
                });
            })();

            // Move modal to body so it's not trapped inside is-hidden-touch aside
            var rcmOverlay = document.getElementById('rcmOverlay');
            if (rcmOverlay) {
                document.body.appendChild(rcmOverlay);
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadSidebarComments);
            } else {
                setTimeout(loadSidebarComments, 500);
            }
        })();
    </script>

                if (wasInitiallyCollapsed || localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                }
            }

            // Enable transitions after initial state is set (double RAF for safety)
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    body.classList.remove('no-transition');
                    body.classList.add('transitions-enabled');
                });
            });
        });

        // Sidebar toggle - Desktop collapses, Mobile opens
        function toggleSidebar() {
            const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
            const desktopSidebar = document.getElementById('desktop-sidebar');
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');
            const body = document.body;

            if (isDesktop && desktopSidebar) {
                // Desktop: Toggle collapse state
                if (desktopSidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
                    body.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
                } else {
                    desktopSidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
                    body.classList.add('sidebar-collapsed');
                    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
                }
            } else if (mobileSidebar) {
                // Mobile: Open sidebar
                mobileSidebar.classList.add('is-active');
                if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('is-active');
                body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        }

        function closeMobileSidebar() {
            const mobileSidebar = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-sidebar-overlay');

            if (mobileSidebar) mobileSidebar.classList.remove('is-active');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('is-active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }

        function openMobileSearch() {
            const searchOverlay = document.getElementById('mobile-search-overlay');
            if (searchOverlay) {
                searchOverlay.classList.add('is-active');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

                // Focus search input after animation
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const input = searchOverlay.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
                    if (input) input.focus();
                }, 300);
            }
        }

        // closeMobileSearch() lives in partials/header-nav.php (it also clears
        // the field and resets the clear-X); a copy here used to load later
        // and override it, so Cancel left the text behind.

        // Close mobile sidebar on escape key
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeMobileSidebar();
                closeMobileSearch();
            }
        });

        // Close mobile sidebar on window resize to desktop
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                closeMobileSidebar();
            }
        });
    </script>

<script>
    (function() {
        var modal = document.getElementById('externalLinkModal');
        if (!modal) return;
        var urlDisplay = document.getElementById('externalLinkUrl');
        var cancelBtn = document.getElementById('externalLinkCancel');
        var continueBtn = document.getElementById('externalLinkContinue');
        var scamWhere = document.getElementById('externalLinkScamWhere');
        var scamVia = document.getElementById('externalLinkScamVia');
        var pendingUrl = null;
        var COUNTDOWN = 5; // seconds Continue stays locked
        var continueLabel = continueBtn.innerHTML;
        var countdownTimer = null;

        // Name the messaging app in the scam warning when we recognize it.
        // Returns '' when the host is not a known messaging app; the "on X"
        // clause is then hidden. Matches the exact domain or a subdomain only,
        // so look-alikes such as notwhatsapp.com are not labeled as the real app.
        function scamChannelName(url) {
            var host = '';
            try { host = new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
            function is(d) { return host === d || host.slice(-(d.length + 1)) === '.' + d; }
            if (is('t.me') || is('telegram.me') || is('telegram.org')) return 'Telegram';
            if (is('wa.me') || is('whatsapp.com')) return 'WhatsApp';
            if (is('fb.com') || is('m.me') || is('facebook.com')) return 'Facebook';
            if (is('instagram.com')) return 'Instagram';
            return '';
        }

        function stopCountdown() {
            if (countdownTimer) { clearInterval(countdownTimer); countdownTimer = null; }
            continueBtn.disabled = false;
            continueBtn.innerHTML = continueLabel;
        }

        function startCountdown() {
            stopCountdown();
            var left = COUNTDOWN;
            var tick = function() {
                continueBtn.textContent = 'Continue (' + left + ')';
                if (left <= 0) { stopCountdown(); return; }
                left--;
            };
            continueBtn.disabled = true;
            tick();
            countdownTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
        }

        function closeModal() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            pendingUrl = null;
            stopCountdown();
        }
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        continueBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (pendingUrl) window.open(pendingUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
            closeModal();
        });
        modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.style.display === 'block') closeModal();
        });
        // curated: true for links the site owner placed (sidebar custom links);
        // they get the plain notice. Everything else is treated as user content.
        // Display only: pendingUrl keeps the full link (referral path/query
        // included) for Continue. Curated links show the bare domain so an
        // owner referral such as /@username never appears in the notice;
        // user-posted links keep the path so members can see where they go.
        window.showExternalLinkWarning = function(url, curated) {
            pendingUrl = url;
            try {
                var u = new URL(url);
                urlDisplay.textContent = curated ? u.hostname : u.hostname + u.pathname;
            } catch (e) {
                urlDisplay.textContent = url;
            }
            var where = scamChannelName(url);
            if (scamWhere) scamWhere.textContent = where;
            if (scamVia) scamVia.hidden = (where === '');
            modal.classList.toggle('is-curated', !!curated);
            modal.style.display = 'block';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            if (curated) stopCountdown(); else startCountdown();
        };
        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var link = e.target.closest('.external-link');
            if (!link) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            showExternalLinkWarning(link.getAttribute('data-url') || link.href, link.getAttribute('data-curated') === '1');
        });
    })();
</script>

        function check() {
            ticking = false;
            var y = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
            var want = y > window.innerHeight * 2;
            if (want !== shown) {
                shown = want;
                btn.classList.toggle('is-visible', shown);

        }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
            if (!ticking) {
                ticking = true;
                window.requestAnimationFrame(check);

        }, { passive: true });

            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });

        var inputEl = document.getElementById('appdlg-input');
        var resolver = null;
        var mode = 'confirm';
        var prevFocus = null;

        function open(opts, newMode) {
            if (typeof opts === 'string') opts = { message: opts };
            opts = opts || {};
            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                if (resolver) settle(false); // a second dialog cancels the first

                cancelBtn.textContent = opts.cancelText || 'Cancel';
